Purang, also known as Taklakot, stands in the Karnali valley of western Tibet, near the routes leading to Nepal and India. The fortress of Tegla Kar once overlooked the town, while nearby Khorchag Monastery marked an old centre of Buddhist learning. The sacred mountain Kailash and Lake Manasarovar lie to the north, drawing pilgrims through the same high country as merchants.

Purang was the seat of a western Tibetan kingdom whose rulers built on the legacy of the older Tibetan royal house. Khorchag was among the early monasteries of this region, and in the fifteenth century came under the Sakya tradition. During the seventeenth century the Gelugpa built the fortified monastery of Shakpel Ling above Taklakot. Its position over the market helped make the town a centre of political and economic power, while Sakya influence continued at Khorchag and within the new monastery's colleges.
simp_chinese:
布让又称塔克拉科特，位于西藏西部格尔纳利河谷，靠近通往尼泊尔和印度的道路。铁甲喀尔堡垒曾俯瞰城镇，附近的科迦寺则是古老的佛教中心。北方有冈仁波齐峰和玛旁雍错，商人与朝圣者都穿行于这片高地。

布让曾是西藏西部一个王国的中心，统治家族继承了古代吐蕃王室的政治传统。科迦寺是当地早期寺院之一，十五世纪转属萨迦派。十七世纪，格鲁派在塔克拉科特上方修筑设防寺院夏培林，俯瞰集市的位置使城镇成为政治和经济中心；萨迦派仍在科迦寺及新寺的经学院内保持影响。

english:
Puri stands on the Bay of Bengal coast of Odisha and is one of the great pilgrimage centres of South Asia. Its great temple of Jagannath, the lord of the universe, dominates the town, and every year the deity is drawn out on a vast wooden chariot in the Rath Yatra along the Grand Road to the Gundicha temple. Pilgrims fed on temple food, bought devotional goods and paid temple servants, and these visits supported lodgings, cooks and carters. Fishing and the rice lands of the coast fed the residents.

The Gajapati kings of Odisha were the protectors of Jagannath, and kings such as Kapilendra and Prataparudra Deva endowed the temple. In 1510 the Bengali saint Chaitanya came to Puri and lived there until his death in 1534, singing and dancing before the deity. After Sulayman Karrani's general Kalapahar attacked Puri in 1568, the images were hidden and later restored. Ramachandra Deva of Khurda, whom the Mughals recognised as ruler of the temple lands in the 1590s, rebuilt the worship and commissioned new images. The temple servants moved the images to safety during later wars.

The Marathas took Odisha in 1751 and levied a pilgrim tax at Puri. After the East India Company conquered Odisha in 1803 it took over the temple administration and kept the tax, and in 1809 supervision passed to the hereditary raja of Khurda.
simp_chinese:
补梨位于奥里萨孟加拉湾海岸，是南亚最伟大的朝圣中心之一。宇宙之主贾加纳特的大神庙统领着全城，每年神像都会被安放在巨大的木制车上，沿大道拉往贡迪查神庙，这就是车节。朝圣者吃神庙的饭食，购买供奉用品，酬谢神庙的侍奉者，这些往来养活了旅店、厨师和车夫。渔业和海岸的稻田则养活着居民。

奥里萨的加贾帕蒂诸王是贾加纳特的守护者，卡皮连德拉和普拉塔普鲁德拉·德瓦等国王向神庙捐赠。1510年，孟加拉圣徒柴坦尼亚来到补梨，在神像前歌舞，一直住到1534年去世。1568年，苏莱曼·卡拉尼的将领卡拉帕哈德进攻补梨后，神像被藏匿，后来重新恢复。1590年代被莫卧儿承认为神庙领地统治者的库尔达的罗摩旃陀罗·德瓦，重建了祭祀并制作了新神像。此后战乱期间，神庙侍奉者也曾把神像迁往安全之处。

1751年马拉塔人夺取奥里萨，在补梨征收朝圣税。1803年东印度公司征服奥里萨后接管神庙管理并保留了这项税收，1809年监管权转交库尔达的世袭拉贾。

english: Puri belongs to the wooded country of Simao in southern Yunnan, where mountain paths connect the tea-growing hills with the country farther north. Under the Yuan, the district appeared in the name of the Buri Simo chieftaincy, subordinate to Yuanjiang. The name Simo was associated with a local bamboo noted for its hard wood and used for houses and tools. The old chieftaincy formed part of a region whose communities maintained their own leaders within the Yuan system of government.
simp_chinese: 普日属于滇南思茅的林山地带，山路将产茶的丘陵与北方连接起来。元代这里的名字见于步日思摩甸长官司，隶属元江路。“思摩”一名与当地一种坚硬的竹子有关，人们用它建屋、制作器具。长官司所在的地区，仍由自己的首领治理，同时纳入元朝行政体系。

english:
Purnia lies in the eastern Bihar plain, a country of rivers between the Kosi and the Mahananda. Under Mughal rule it gave its name to a sarkar, or administrative district, within the province of Bengal. The land was connected to both the Bihar plain and Bengal, and its governors held authority over an extensive frontier district.

In the eighteenth century Purnia passed from the government of the nawabs into the hands of the English East India Company. The Company acquired revenue rights in Bengal and Bihar in 1765, and established a district administration at Purnia in 1770. The same year brought the great Bengal famine, remembered for its severe toll across the wider region. European settlements and indigo cultivation later became features of the district’s economy.
simp_chinese:
布尔尼亚位于比哈尔东部平原，地处戈西河与默哈嫩达河之间的河流地带。莫卧儿统治时期，孟加拉省下辖的一处萨尔卡尔，即行政区，以它命名。这里既与比哈尔平原相连，也与孟加拉相接，其总督统辖着广阔的边缘地区。

十八世纪，布尔尼亚从纳瓦布的统治转入英国东印度公司手中。公司于1765年获得孟加拉和比哈尔的税收权，1770年在布尔尼亚建立地区行政机构。同年爆发的孟加拉大饥荒，在这一广大地区造成惨重损失。此后，欧洲人的聚居地和靛蓝种植成为当地经济的一部分。

sources.title: The Imperial gazetteer  of India Vol-20 (Pardi to Pusad).pdf

english: Pursat lies between the Tonle Sap and the forested Cardamom Mountains. Rivers descending from the hills cross the plain toward the great lake, while the mountains yield the aromatic cardamom that gave the range its name. In the early nineteenth century merchants carried Cambodian cardamom through Pursat and Battambang for sale to Siam. The spice was prized in trade with China as well as in the markets of mainland Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 菩萨位于洞里萨湖与森林覆盖的豆蔻山脉之间。河流从山中流下，穿过平原奔向大湖；山地出产芳香的豆蔻，山脉也因此得名。十九世纪前期，商人将柬埔寨豆蔻经菩萨和马德望运往暹罗。这种香料在中国贸易和东南亚大陆市场上都受到重视。

english:
Puruarán lies near Tacámbaro in the highlands of Michoacán, on the edge of the warmer country to the south. An estate here became the scene of a major defeat for the Mexican insurgents during their war against Spanish rule. Its fields and walls briefly formed part of a defensive position as royalist forces approached.

After the insurgent attack on Valladolid failed in December 1813, the army of José María Morelos fell back toward Puruarán. On 5 January 1814 royalist troops attacked the forces gathered at the hacienda. The insurgents were defeated and Mariano Matamoros, one of their leading commanders, was captured. He was executed at Valladolid the following month. The defeat deprived Morelos of a close lieutenant and marked a turning point in the southern campaign.
simp_chinese:
普鲁阿兰位于米却肯高地的塔坎巴罗附近，地处南方温暖地带的边缘。独立战争中，这里的一座庄园成为墨西哥起义军遭遇重大失败的战场。保王军逼近时，田地与围墙一度成为防御阵地的一部分。

1813年12月，起义军进攻巴利亚多利德失利后，何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯的军队退向普鲁阿兰。1814年1月5日，保王军进攻集结在庄园的部队。起义军战败，主要指挥官之一马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯被俘，次月在巴利亚多利德被处决。这场失败使莫雷洛斯失去一名亲密的副手，也成为南方战局的转折点。

english: The Puruborá are an Indigenous people of the Guaporé basin. Their traditions trace their origins to the Branco River, where they lived near the Makurap, Aruá and Tupari, before moving to the valley of the São Miguel, a tributary of the Guaporé. Their language belongs to the Tupian stock, and their country encompasses forest and the streams that join the São Miguel.
simp_chinese: 普鲁博拉人是瓜波雷流域的原住民族。按照他们的传统，他们原先生活在布兰科河畔，与马库拉普、阿鲁阿和图帕里人相邻，后来迁往瓜波雷河支流圣米格尔河的河谷。他们的语言属于图皮语族，生活的土地包括森林以及汇入圣米格尔河的溪流。

english: Puruga lies near the upper Flinders River, in the inland country around Hughenden. Yirandhali people belong to this part of northwestern Queensland, including the country around the Flinders and Dutton rivers and Landsborough Creek. The Flinders runs westward across the dry interior towards the Gulf of Carpentaria. Waterholes along its course and the surrounding creek country have long formed part of an Aboriginal landscape whose occupation reaches far into the past.
simp_chinese: 普鲁加位于弗林德斯河上游、休恩登附近的内陆地区。伊兰达利人属于昆士兰西北部这一带，其土地包括弗林德斯河、达顿河和兰兹伯勒溪周围。弗林德斯河向西流经干旱内陆，最终通往卡奔塔利亚湾。沿河水潭与周围溪流地带长期属于原住民生活的土地，其居住历史可追溯至遥远的过去。

english: The Purus winds north through the western Amazon before joining the Solimões. Its exceptionally sinuous course crosses a broad floodplain, leaving oxbow lakes as the river shifts. Near the mouth of the Pauini, a tributary of the Purus, seasonal floods spread through forest and floating meadows; lakes and channels offer fish habitat across the low country.
simp_chinese: 普鲁斯河蜿蜒流经亚马孙西部，向北汇入索利蒙伊斯河。河道极为曲折，穿过宽阔的泛滥平原；河流改道时留下牛轭湖。普鲁斯河支流保伊尼河的河口附近，季节洪水漫入森林和浮生草甸，湖泊与水道为低地鱼类提供栖息环境。

english: Purutu lies among the rivers and tidal channels of the Gulf of Papua. Coastal communities used these waterways within a wider exchange world. Motu sailors from the Port Moresby area carried pottery to the gulf on hiri voyages and exchanged it for sago and canoe hulls.
simp_chinese: 普鲁图位于巴布亚湾的河流与潮汐水道之间。沿岸社群在更广阔的交换世界中利用这些水路。莫尔兹比港地区的莫图水手在希里航行中将陶器带到海湾，交换西米和独木舟船体。

english: Puruvesi is a clear-water basin of the Saimaa lake system in eastern Finland. Broad open waters are divided by islands and peninsulas formed from sandy ridges, while narrow straits connect the lake with neighbouring waters. Its fish include abundant vendace, a small freshwater fish that has supported a long local tradition of net fishing on the lake.
simp_chinese: 普鲁韦西是芬兰东部塞马湖水系中水质清澈的一片水域。开阔湖面被沙脊形成的岛屿和半岛分隔，狭窄水道则连接邻近湖泊。湖中盛产小型淡水鱼西鲱，沿湖居民长久以来以网捕捞这种鱼。

english: Purbalingga lies inland in western Central Java, in the country associated with Banyumas and its rulers. Local chronicles tell how Kyai Arsayuda, known as Dipayuda III, moved his seat from Karanglewas to the village of Purbalingga on the advice of his father Arsantaka. A residence, audience pavilion and square were built for the new centre. After the Java War, the Dutch reorganised the region, and Purbalingga became a regency in 1830.
simp_chinese: 普尔巴灵加位于中爪哇西部内陆，属于与万由马士及其统治者有关的地区。地方编年史讲述，基艾·阿尔萨尤达，即迪帕尤达三世，听从父亲阿尔桑塔卡的建议，将治所从卡朗勒瓦斯迁往普尔巴灵加村。新中心建有住宅、接待亭和广场。爪哇战争结束后，荷兰人重新安排当地政务，普尔巴灵加于1830年成为摄政区。

english: Pushang, also called Fushanj, was a town of eastern Khorasan southwest of Herat and south of the Hari River. It existed before the Islamic conquest, and tradition attributed its foundation and a bridge to the Sasanian king Shapur I. Herat and its surroundings passed between Sasanian and Hephthalite power before the Arabs arrived. The old town belonged to the chain of settled places along the Hari valley, west of the great oasis of Herat.
simp_chinese: 普尚又称富尚杰，是东呼罗珊的一座城镇，位于赫拉特西南、哈里河南岸。它在伊斯兰征服前便已存在；传说萨珊国王沙普尔一世建造了此城和一座桥。阿拉伯人到来之前，赫拉特及周边曾在萨珊人与嚈哒人之间易手。这座古城属于哈里河谷沿线的聚落地带，位于赫拉特大绿洲以西。

english: Pushkino lies north-east of Moscow on an old road leading toward Pereyaslavl, Yaroslavl and Vologda. The village is documented in a survey of 1499. One account associates its name with the boyar Grigory Morkhinin, known as Pushka, whose descendants included the family of the poet Alexander Pushkin. The village’s location placed it along a route used by travellers and traders moving between Moscow and the towns of the north-east.
simp_chinese: 普希金诺位于莫斯科东北方，坐落在通往佩列亚斯拉夫尔、雅罗斯拉夫尔和沃洛格达的古道上。1499年的调查记载了这个村庄。一种说法认为，村名与绰号「普什卡」的贵族格里戈里·莫尔希宁有关；他的后代中包括诗人亚历山大·普希金的家族。村庄所在的道路供往来莫斯科与东北方城镇的旅人和商人使用。

english: The Middle Popo Agie River descends from the Wind River Range into the basin below. In a canyon at the mountain's foot, the stream disappears into a limestone cavern and emerges again farther downstream. The river country formed part of a wider landscape used by Shoshone communities for hunting and travel. During the 1820s, traders and trappers began holding gatherings in the neighbouring Green and Wind river country, meeting Indigenous partners to exchange goods and furs.
simp_chinese: 波波阿吉河中叉从温德河山脉流向下方盆地。在山脚的一处峡谷中，河水钻入石灰岩洞穴，随后又在下游重见天日。河流地区属于肖肖尼社群狩猎、往来的广大土地。十九世纪二十年代，商人与捕兽者开始在邻近的绿河与温德河地区举行集会，与原住民伙伴交换货物和皮毛。

english: Pusiga occupies a special place in the traditions of the kingdoms of the northern savanna. It is associated with Naa Gbewaa, remembered as an ancestral ruler of the Mamprusi, Dagomba and Nanumba peoples. Accounts tell how his descendants established kingdoms in different parts of the region after his death. A shrine at Pusiga preserves his memory, linking the settlement to royal histories that stretch across the savanna towards Gambaga, Dagbon and the Mossi country.
simp_chinese: 普西加在北方草原诸王国的传统中占有特殊地位。这里与纳·格贝瓦相联系，他被尊为曼普鲁西、达贡巴和纳农巴人的祖先统治者。传说讲述他去世后，后代如何在地区各处建立王国。普西加的圣所保存着对他的记忆，将聚落与延伸至甘巴加、达格邦及莫西地区的王室历史联系起来。

english: Pusilhá was a Maya city in the forested south of Belize, near rivers flowing toward the Caribbean. Its plazas, ballcourts and carved stelae preserve evidence of a ruling dynasty in the Late Classic period. Inscriptions record events over two centuries and connect the city with the wider political world of the Maya lowlands. The carved monuments and elaborate buildings of its center stand among the remains of a once much larger landscape of settlements.
simp_chinese: 普西拉是伯利兹南部森林中的一座玛雅城市，靠近流向加勒比海的河流。广场、球场和雕刻石碑保存了古典期晚期统治王朝的痕迹。铭文记载了跨越两个世纪的事件，将这座城市与更广阔的玛雅低地政治世界联系起来。中心区的雕刻纪念碑和精美建筑，坐落在曾经更为广大的聚落遗迹之中。

english: Pustosel lies on the Oster River west of Roslavl, among the forests and fields of the Smolensk region. The Oster flows westward toward the Sozh, part of the Dnieper basin. Its valley runs through country once crossed by routes between Smolensk, Roslavl and the lands farther west. The village's name evokes a deserted settlement, a common element in the place names of this wooded borderland.
simp_chinese: 普斯托谢尔坐落在罗斯拉夫尔以西的奥斯焦尔河畔，周围是斯摩棱斯克地区的森林和田野。奥斯焦尔河向西流入索日河，属于第聂伯河流域。河谷穿过的土地曾有道路连接斯摩棱斯克、罗斯拉夫尔和更西方的地区。村名令人想起荒废的聚落，这类名称在林木覆盖的边境地带并不罕见。

english:
Pustozersk was founded in 1499 on the lower Pechora by Princes Semyon Kurbsky and Pyotr Ushaty. Its name, “place of empty lakes,” recalled the barren country around this northern outpost. The fortress was the first Russian settlement on the Pechora and served as an administrative center for the Pechora and Yugra lands. Its position placed it among the rivers and tundra of the far north, at the edge of Muscovy's expanding authority.

In the seventeenth century Pustozersk was also a place of exile. The Old Believer leader Avvakum was imprisoned here and ultimately burned at the stake; the boyar Artamon Matveyev and Prince Vasily Golitsyn were among other notable exiles. From 1644 the town faced repeated attacks by Samoyedic peoples. In the eighteenth century it lost much of its economic importance as a more convenient southern route across the Urals to Siberia drew traffic away.
simp_chinese:
普斯托泽尔斯克于1499年由谢苗·库尔布斯基和彼得·乌沙特公爵建立，位于伯朝拉河下游。地名意为“空湖之地”，令人想起北方前哨周围荒凉的土地。这座堡垒是伯朝拉河上的首个俄罗斯聚落，也是伯朝拉和尤格拉地区的行政中心。它坐落在极北的河流和苔原之间，处于莫斯科不断扩展的权力边缘。

十七世纪，普斯托泽尔斯克也是流放地。旧礼仪派领袖阿瓦库姆被囚禁于此，最终被处以火刑；波雅尔阿尔塔蒙·马特维耶夫和瓦西里·戈利岑公爵也是著名流放者。1644年起，城镇屡遭萨莫耶德人的袭击。十八世纪，越过乌拉尔山通往西伯利亚的更便利南线分流了交通，普斯托泽尔斯克的经济地位逐渐下降。

english: Putao lies in the far northern mountain country near the upper Mali Hka, below the snowy peaks of the eastern Himalaya. Hkakabo Razi rises to the north above deep river valleys and forested ridges. Evergreen forest in the lower valleys gives way to cooler mountain woods and alpine meadows; glaciers in the high ranges feed the rivers that gather into the Irrawaddy farther south.
simp_chinese: 葡萄位于极北山地，靠近梅立开江上游，东喜马拉雅的雪峰耸立在北方。北面的开加博峰高出深邃河谷和森林山脊。低谷的常绿林向上逐渐过渡为凉爽的山地林与高山草甸；高山冰川补给的河流向南汇集，最终形成伊洛瓦底江。

sources.title: Report Local Governance Mapping Kachin UNDP Feb2015.pdf

english:
Pútián spreads across the Xīnghuà plain, where the Mùlán Stream runs east into Xīnghuà Bay, the meeting point of northern and southern Fújiàn. The Yuán made it Xīnghuà Route and the Míng Xīnghuà Prefecture, paired with Xiānyóu, and the district was known for its examination graduates: a school stood on Southern Mountain as early as about 558, and Tang-era Pútián boasted the Lín family of nine prefects.

Three kilometers offshore lies Méizhōu Island, where villagers honored a local woman as Māzǔ, protector of seafarers, and where her ancestral temple stands. In late 1562 Japanese pirates took the prefectural city; in 1563 Qī Jìguāng and Yú Dàyóu destroyed their last base at Pínghǎi Garrison and recovered it. The hard biscuit carried by Qī's soldiers, the Jìguāng biscuit, became a local food. The Qīng coastal evacuation of the 1660s struck the shore, and after Taiwan fell to the Qīng the court honored Māzǔ as Empress of Heaven.
simp_chinese:
莆田位于兴化平原，木兰溪向东注入兴化湾，是闽东与闽南的连接点。元代这里设兴化路，明代设兴化府，与仙游并为府下两县，以科举人才著称：南朝陈永定二年（558年）前后南山就有湖山书堂，唐代莆田又出了“一门九刺史”的林家。

离岸约三公里的湄洲岛上，乡人把当地林姓女子奉为保护航海者的妈祖，祖庙就在岛上。嘉靖四十一年（1562年）末，倭寇攻陷兴化府城；次年，戚继光、俞大猷摧毁倭寇在平海卫的最后据点，收复府城。戚家军行军所带的干粮“光饼”，也叫继光饼，成了当地小吃。清初的迁界令冲击了沿海，清军收复台湾之后，朝廷又加封妈祖为天后。

english:
Putna lies among the wooded hills of northern Moldavia, beside the river of the same name. Here Stephen the Great founded a monastery intended as the burial place of his family. Its church, dedicated to the Dormition of the Mother of God, was begun in 1466 and consecrated in 1469. Gifts and privileges from its founder made Putna one of the foremost monasteries of the principality.

Work on the buildings and defences continued through Stephen's reign. His sons Bogdan and Peter were buried here in 1479 and 1480, and Stephen himself was laid to rest at Putna in 1504. The monastery also nurtured manuscript work and precious embroidery; the tomb covering of his wife Maria of Mangup bears a life-size portrait. A fire in 1484 damaged the complex, which was subsequently rebuilt and enlarged.
simp_chinese:
普特纳位于摩尔达维亚北部的林木丘陵中，坐落在同名河畔。斯特凡大公在此创建修道院，作为家族的安葬之所。献给圣母安息的教堂于1466年动工，1469年祝圣。创建者的捐赠和特权使普特纳成为公国最重要的修道院之一。

斯特凡在位期间，建筑与防御工程持续进行。他的儿子博格丹和彼得鲁分别于1479和1480年葬于此，斯特凡本人也于1504年安息在普特纳。修道院还培育手抄本制作和精美刺绣；其妻曼古普的玛丽亚墓盖上绣有真人大小的肖像。1484年一场火灾损坏了建筑群，修道院随后得到重建与扩充。

english: Putyatino lies southeast of Ryazan, in a countryside of fields and woodland near the old routes toward Shatsk. The village belonged to members of the Godunov family at the end of the sixteenth century and appears in Ryazan tax records of 1628–1629. Later owners included a son of Prince Dmitry Pozharsky and members of the Vysheslavtsev family. To the northeast, tradition locates the Shishevsky Forest, where Ryazan and allied princes defeated a Horde force in 1365.
simp_chinese: 普佳季诺位于梁赞东南，周围是田野与林地，靠近通往沙茨克的古道。16世纪末，村庄属于戈东诺夫家族成员，并见于1628至1629年的梁赞赋税文书。后来的所有者包括德米特里·波扎尔斯基亲王之子和维舍斯拉夫采夫家族成员。东北方向的希舍夫斯基森林据传是1365年梁赞及盟友诸亲王击败汗国军队的地点。

english: Putyvl stands in the Seim River country of Severia. First mentioned in 1146, it was a fortified town contested by the principalities of Chernihiv and Novhorod-Siverskyi. Lithuania took it in the fourteenth century, and it passed to Muscovy after the Battle of Vedrosha in 1500. During the Time of Troubles, Putyvl briefly served the forces of False Dmitry I and became a centre of Ivan Bolotnikov's uprising. The Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth occupied it from 1607 to 1619. The Movchanskyi Monastery reflects the town's religious life: its cathedral was begun in the 1590s, and much of the complex dates from the seventeenth century. The surviving fortifications and churches recall a frontier town repeatedly drawn into wider political conflict.
simp_chinese: 普季夫尔位于谢韦里亚的塞姆河地区，1146年首次见于记载，曾是切尔尼戈夫与新哥罗德－谢韦尔斯基诸公争夺的要塞。十四世纪它被立陶宛占领，1500年韦德罗沙战役后转归莫斯科。动乱时代，普季夫尔一度成为伪德米特里一世势力的据点，后来又是伊万·博洛特尼科夫起义的中心。1607至1619年，波兰立陶宛联邦占领此城。莫夫昌斯基修道院体现当地宗教生活：其主教堂始建于1590年代，院内大部分建筑属于十七世纪。城防和教堂见证了这座边地城镇反复卷入更大范围的政治冲突。

english: Puula, also called Puulavesi, is a large lake in the wooded country west of Mikkeli. Its waters wind around numerous islands and peninsulas, opening routes among the shores of southern Savolax. For centuries the lake drained westward towards Päijänne through a chain of waterways. Its bays and passages formed part of a landscape in which water joined communities separated by forest and ridges.
simp_chinese: 普拉湖又称普拉韦西湖，是米凯利以西林地中的大湖。湖水在众多岛屿和半岛之间蜿蜒，为南萨沃拉克斯各处湖岸提供水路。数百年来，湖水经一系列水道向西流入派耶讷湖；海湾与水道将被森林和沙脊分隔的社区联系起来。

english: The tundra between the Anabar and Olenyok basins forms part of northern Siberia’s Arctic lowlands. Lakes, wetlands and rivers lie across ground underlain by permafrost; the long frozen season gives way to a brief summer thaw. Indigenous peoples including Evenki and their neighbours travelled the wider northern country, using knowledge of rivers and seasonal conditions to move across it.
simp_chinese: 阿纳巴尔河与奥廖尼奥克河流域之间的苔原属于西伯利亚北部北极低地。湖泊、湿地和河流分布于永久冻土之上，漫长冰封季节之后是短暂的夏季融化期。包括鄂温克人及其邻居在内的原住民往来于广阔北方地带，凭借对河流和季节条件的认识穿越这片土地。

english:
Puvina-Padangile, now called Huvina Hadagali, was a settlement known for temples and gardens in the Tungabhadra country. An inscription of 1090 records that Rebbaladevi, wife of a Chalukya general, built the Keshava temple in her birthplace and endowed it with land. Other records name its learned assembly and gifts for worship. Tradition says flowers from the village were floated down the Tungabhadra for the temples and palaces of Vijayanagara.

An inscription dated 1620 records Komaraiah, son of Basavappa Nayaka, as governor of the local fort under a Vijayanagara king. It describes works including fortifications, a tank, a well and a meeting place. The record shows a local community still building and maintaining its settlement after the imperial court had moved away from the old capital.
simp_chinese:
普维纳‑帕当吉莱今称胡维纳哈达加利，是通加巴德拉河地区以神庙和花园闻名的聚落。1090年的铭文记载，遮娄其将领之妻雷巴拉德维在自己的出生地建造凯舍瓦神庙，并捐赠土地。其他记录提到当地学者会议及用于祭祀的捐赠。传说村庄的鲜花沿通加巴德拉河运往毗奢耶那伽罗的神庙和宫殿。

一处1620年的铭文记载巴萨瓦帕·那耶迦之子科马赖亚在毗奢耶那伽罗国王之下管理当地堡垒，文中列出防御工事、水池、水井和会议场所等工程。这一记录显示，即使帝国宫廷已迁离旧都，地方社群仍在建设和维护自己的聚落。

english: Puxian lies in the mountains of western Shanxi. East of the town, the Dongyue Temple crowns Mount Bai, its halls dedicated to the deity of the eastern sacred mountain. The main hall dates from the Yuan dynasty, while later builders added galleries and pavilions around it. Ming-period painted sculptures populate the temple's chambers of hell with judges, officials, and the souls undergoing punishment, giving vivid form to beliefs about the world beyond death.
simp_chinese: 蒲县位于山西西部山区。城东柏山之巅的东岳庙供奉东岳大帝，主殿建于元代，后人又增建楼阁回廊。庙中地狱府保存着明代彩塑，判官、鬼吏和受刑的亡魂共同呈现了人们对死后世界的想象。

english: The Puyallup lived in villages along the winding river that bears their name and around the shores of southern Puget Sound. Their cedar longhouses stood near waters rich in salmon and shellfish, while the valleys supplied game, berries, and roots such as camas and wapato. Their homeland reached from the river toward Commencement Bay and the islands of the sound.
simp_chinese: 皮阿拉普人居住在同名河流蜿蜒的河道沿线，以及普吉特湾南部的海岸。他们的雪松长屋靠近盛产鲑鱼和贝类的水域，河谷还提供猎物、浆果，以及卡马斯和野慈姑等植物的根茎。他们的家园从河流延伸至康门斯门特湾和海湾中的岛屿。

english:
Puyang lies on the flat alluvial plain north of the Yellow River, taking its name from its position on the sunny north bank of the old Pu River, which the floods later silted up. Tomb burials of dragons and tigers laid out in clamshell, found at Xishuipo and some 6,400 years old, show how early the plain was settled; in 629 BC the state of Wei moved its capital to nearby Diqiu. In 1004 the Song emperor Zhenzong came to the walls of Chanzhou, as the town was then called, and sealed the Treaty of Chanyuan with the Liao.

From 1144 the town was the seat of Kaizhou, under the Jin, Yuan and Ming alike. In 1369 the Ming merged Puyang County into the department, and the Qing placed Kaizhou under Daming Prefecture. The river that watered the district also broke its banks and shifted its course again and again, silting the old channels and shifting the settlements beside them.
simp_chinese:
濮阳坐落在黄河北岸平坦的冲积平原上，得名于古濮水之北，那条河后来被洪水淤没。西水坡出土的蚌壳摆塑龙虎墓葬距今约6400年，可见这片平原开发之早；公元前629年卫国迁都到附近的帝丘。景德元年（1004年），宋真宗亲临当时称澶州的城下，与辽订立澶渊之盟。

金皇统四年（1144年）起，这里是开州治所，金、元、明三朝相沿。明洪武二年（1369年）濮阳县并入开州，清代开州隶属大名府。滋养这一带的黄河，也一再决口改道，淤塞旧河道，改变沿岸聚落的位置。

english: The forests of Puyehue grow on the wet Andean slopes east of the great lakes of southern Chile. Volcanoes, hot springs and rivers punctuate a landscape shaped by both volcanic activity and glaciers. Dense native woodland covers the lower slopes, while higher ground rises towards exposed peaks and snow. Streams descend through the forest into the lake basins, forming part of the waterways that run westward towards the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 普耶韦森林生长在智利南部大湖以东湿润的安第斯山坡上。火山、温泉和河流点缀着火山活动与冰川共同塑造的地貌。山坡低处覆盖茂密的本地林木，高处则升向裸露的山峰和积雪。溪流穿过森林流入湖盆，汇入向西流向太平洋的水系。

english: Lake Puyehue lies at the foot of the southern Andes, surrounded by wooded hills and volcanic mountains. Its waters belong to the basin of the Bueno River, which carries them westwards towards the Pacific. The lake and its neighbouring valleys form part of the territory inhabited by Huilliche communities. Mountain streams feed the basin, while rain sustains the dense forests that cover much of the surrounding land.
simp_chinese: 普耶韦湖位于南安第斯山麓，周围环绕森林丘陵和火山。湖水属于布埃诺河流域，河水向西流入太平洋。湖泊与附近河谷是维利切社群居住的土地的一部分。山间溪流汇入湖盆，雨水则滋养着覆盖周边大片土地的茂密森林。

english: Puyin was the seat of Qizhou on the central Hebei plain. The county received its name under the Song and was absorbed into the prefecture in the early Ming. Its market became associated with the temple of the Medicine King: temple fairs drew buyers and sellers and developed into a trade in medicinal herbs. The city's walls, repaired and enlarged from the late fifteenth century, enclosed a centre of administration and exchange.
simp_chinese: 蒲阴是河北中部平原祁州的治所，宋代得名，明初省县入州。当地药王庙的庙会吸引商贩，逐渐发展出药材交易。城墙自十五世纪末起多次增修，环绕着这座行政与贸易中心。

english: Puyu lies in the forested country of the upper Pastaza, where rivers descend from the eastern slopes of the Ecuadorian Andes. This wet tropical landscape was inhabited by diverse Indigenous communities long before the later town of Puyo was founded. During the colonial era, the wider Pastaza region saw contact among peoples including the Shuar, Zápara and Kichwa-speaking communities, as well as the arrival of missionaries.
simp_chinese: 普尤位于帕斯塔萨河上游的森林地带，河流从厄瓜多尔安第斯东坡流入这里。后来的普约城镇建立之前很久，不同原住民社群已居住在这片湿润的热带地区。殖民时期，更广阔的帕斯塔萨地区见证了舒阿尔人、萨帕拉人与基丘亚语社群等族群之间的接触，也迎来了传教士。

english: Puyu Huapi is associated with the fjord and channel of Puyuhuapi on the wet coast of western Patagonia. Its waters lie among forested mountains and islands, with the Jacaf channel connecting them to the Pacific. The name comes from Mapudungun words associated with a small fish and an island. Glaciers and streams descend from the Queulat mountains into this landscape of narrow waterways and dense evergreen forest.
simp_chinese: 普尤瓦皮与巴塔哥尼亚西部湿润海岸的普尤瓦皮峡湾和水道有关。水域位于森林山地与岛屿之间，哈卡夫水道将其与太平洋相连。名称源于马普切语中与小鱼和岛屿有关的词。冰川与溪流从克拉特山地下降，进入这片狭窄水道和茂密常绿林组成的景观。

english: The Puyuguapi Channel separates Magdalena Island from the Patagonian mainland, connecting the Moraleda Channel with a network of fjords. Rivers descend into its eastern shore from the forested mountains, including the Queulat and Cisnes. This sheltered waterway forms part of the intricate system of islands, peninsulas and channels that characterises the western coast of Patagonia.
simp_chinese: 普尤瓜皮水道将马格达莱纳岛与巴塔哥尼亚大陆分开，连接莫拉莱达水道和峡湾网络。克拉特河、西斯内斯河等河流从森林覆盖的山岭流入东岸。这条受庇护的水道是巴塔哥尼亚西岸复杂的岛屿、半岛和水道体系的一部分。

english: Pyalitsa lies on the Tersky coast of the White Sea, near the mouth of its namesake river. In the sixteenth century it was a seasonal fishing station on the boundary of the lands used by the Tersky Sámi. Records describe their fishing grounds extending eastward from the Pyalitsa along the coast, including rivers and fishing stations. Pomor fishers also used such stations for the salmon catch, living on the shore while the season lasted.
simp_chinese: 皮亚利察位于白海捷尔斯基海岸，靠近同名河流的河口。十六世纪，这里是季节性渔场，处在捷尔斯基萨米人使用土地的边界。记录显示，他们的渔场从皮亚利察沿海岸向东延伸，包括多条河流和捕鱼站。波莫尔渔民也利用这样的渔站捕捞鲑鱼，渔季期间居住在海岸上。

english:
Pyay, long known as Prome, stands on the Irrawaddy at an important meeting of upper and lower Burma. Southeast of the town lie the walls and stupas of Sri Ksetra, an ancient Pyu city. Above Pyay itself rises the Shwesandaw Pagoda, revered for a relic of the Buddha. Kings of Pagan and later Burmese rulers repaired and enlarged the shrine, leaving inscriptions and stairways that record generations of patronage.

As the power of Ava weakened in the late fifteenth century, Prome became the centre of a kingdom of its own. Its rulers fought and negotiated with Ava and other neighbours until the expanding Toungoo kingdom captured the city in 1542. Tabinshwehti then made it a provincial centre. In 1754 Alaungpaya seized Prome during his campaigns to reunite Burma; two years later he gilded Shwesandaw and added an umbrella to its spire. The city remained a significant river crossing and religious centre under the Konbaung kings.
simp_chinese:
卑谬坐落在伊洛瓦底江畔，是上缅甸与下缅甸之间的重要交汇处。城东南有古骠人城市室利差呾罗的城墙和佛塔；卑谬城内的高处则矗立着供奉佛陀舍利的瑞山都塔。蒲甘及后来的缅甸国王修葺、扩建这座圣地，留下碑铭和阶梯，记录历代的供奉。

十五世纪末，阿瓦势力衰弱，卑谬成为独立王国的中心。当地统治者与阿瓦等邻国时战时和，直到1542年不断扩张的东吁王国攻取此城。德彬瑞梯随后将它设为地方中心。1754年，雍笈牙在重新统一缅甸的战争中夺取卑谬；两年后，他为瑞山都塔镀金，并在塔顶增设宝伞。贡榜王朝时期，这里仍是重要的渡江地点和宗教中心。

english: Pyemmairrener country belongs to the northern part of lutruwita, or Tasmania, among the island’s Aboriginal lands and waters. Rivers and wooded country extend towards the coast of Bass Strait. From the late eighteenth century sealers entered the strait; after British settlement in 1803, conflict and dispossession increasingly affected Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 皮迈伦纳地区位于卢特鲁维塔即塔斯马尼亚北部，属于岛上原住民土地与水域。河流和林地向巴斯海峡海岸延伸。十八世纪末，猎海豹者进入海峡；1803年英国人定居后，冲突与土地剥夺愈发影响原住民社群。

english: P'yŏngch'ang lies among the mountains of Korea's eastern interior. Its district includes Mount Odae, a revered Buddhist landscape of temples and hermitages. At Wŏlchŏngsa stands an octagonal nine-storey stone pagoda dating from the Koryŏ period. Tradition holds that the monk Naong stayed at nearby Mirŭgam after returning from China, before King Kongmin summoned him to the capital to serve as royal preceptor.
simp_chinese: 平昌位于朝鲜东部内陆群山之中。境内的五台山是受人崇敬的佛教圣地，分布着寺院与庵堂。月精寺有一座高丽时期的八角九层石塔。相传僧人懒翁从中国归来后，曾在附近的弥勒庵修行，随后受恭愍王召赴都城，担任王师。

english: P'yŏnggang lies on a broad upland plain north of Ch'ŏrwŏn, where rivers cut deep valleys through the old lava landscape. It received its name in 1018 under Koryŏ and was governed as a dependency of Tongju. Its position on a route through the interior brought hardship during invasions: Khitan forces passed through in 1217, and Japanese armies advanced through the district in 1592.
simp_chinese: 平康位于铁原以北宽广的高地平原，河流在古老的熔岩地貌中切出深谷。高丽于1018年赋予此名，将其作为东州属县治理。它处在内陆要路上，战争时屡遭劫难：契丹军于1217年经过，日军也在1592年入侵时穿过此地北上。

english: P'yŏngju, later P'yŏngsan, lies on the road northwest from Kaesŏng through the hills of Hwanghae. Its strategic position gave it a succession of fortified strongholds. The Joseon court raised it to a protectorate in 1413; in the mid-fifteenth century it was one of the province's larger towns. King Sŏnjo stopped in the district while fleeing to Ŭiju during the Japanese invasion of 1592.
simp_chinese: 平州后来称为平山，位于开城向西北穿过黄海丘陵的道路上。战略位置使这里历来设有多处堡垒。朝鲜朝廷于1413年将其升为都护府；十五世纪中叶，平山是本道较大的城邑之一。1592年日军入侵时，宣祖逃往义州途中曾在此停留。

english: Pyhäjärvi, the Holy Lake, lies on the Karelian Isthmus south of Lake Ladoga. Forests and low hills surround its long waters, which belong to the lake country between the Gulf of Finland and Ladoga. The shores have long attracted people to fish and settle; archaeological remains around the lake reach back into the Stone Age and the early metal-using periods.
simp_chinese: 皮海耶尔维意为「圣湖」，位于拉多加湖以南的卡累利阿地峡。森林和低丘环绕着狭长的湖水，这里属于芬兰湾与拉多加湖之间的湖区。湖岸长久以来吸引人们捕鱼和定居，周围的考古遗迹可追溯到石器时代和早期金属时代。

english: Pyinmana lies in the upper Sittaung valley, north of Taungoo. The river rises in the central highlands and flows south between the Pegu Yoma and the eastern hills. Villages and cultivated land occupy the valley, with forested ridges beyond. The town's position links the dry country of Upper Burma with the route south towards Taungoo, the royal centre from which a powerful Burmese dynasty expanded in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 彬马那位于锡当河上游谷地，在东吁以北。锡当河发源于中部高地，在勃固山脉与东部丘陵之间向南流去。村落和耕地分布于谷中，远处则是森林覆盖的山岭。这里连接上缅甸的干燥地带与通往东吁的南方道路；十六世纪，一个强大的缅甸王朝正是从东吁王都向外扩张。

english: The Pykopcatêjê, also called Pykopjê, are a Timbira people of southwestern Maranhão. Their country lies where Amazonian forest meets the more open vegetation of the cerrado, around the upper Pindaré and neighbouring rivers. They speak a Jê language and share social and ceremonial traditions with other Timbira peoples, while maintaining a distinct identity among their neighbours.
simp_chinese: 皮科普卡泰杰人也称皮科普杰人，是马拉尼昂西南部的廷比拉民族。其土地位于亚马孙森林与较为开阔的塞拉多植被交接处，包括上平达雷河及邻近河流地区。他们使用热语，与其他廷比拉民族拥有相近的社会与仪式传统，同时在邻族之间保有独特身份。

english: Pyli stands at the entrance to a gorge between Mount Itamos and Mount Koziakas, where the Portaikos River emerges towards the Thessalian plain. Its name means a gate, fitting a passage that links Thessaly with the mountains on the way to Arta. The ancient traveller Pausanias knew the place as the Great Gates. In 1283 John Doukas, ruler of Thessaly, founded the monastery of Porta Panagia nearby, leaving a Byzantine church at the threshold of the Pindus.
simp_chinese: 皮利坐落在伊塔莫斯山与科齐亚卡斯山之间的峡谷入口，波尔泰科斯河从这里流向色萨利平原。它的名字意为“门”，恰如其分地描述了这条连接色萨利与通往阿尔塔山区的道路。古代旅行家保萨尼亚斯称此地为“大门”。1283年，色萨利统治者约翰·杜卡斯在附近创建波尔塔帕纳吉亚修道院，在品都斯山脉的入口留下一座拜占庭教堂。

english: Pyras was a Komi settlement near the meeting of the Vychegda and Northern Dvina. The Vychegda-Vym chronicle places Stephen of Perm's preaching and baptisms at Pyras and on the Viled in 1379, at the beginning of his mission among the Permian peoples. The site lay on a major river route linking the northern interior with the White Sea. In 1675 the Dutch merchant Balthasar Coyett passed the shoals near Pyras on his journey along the Dvina and Sukhona.
simp_chinese: 皮拉斯是维切格达河与北德维纳河汇合处附近的一座科米人聚落。维切格达—维姆编年史记载，1379年，彼尔姆的斯捷潘在皮拉斯和维列季河一带传教、施洗，开启了他在彼尔姆诸族中的传教事业。此地位于连接北方内陆与白海的重要水路上。1675年，荷兰商人巴尔塔萨尔·科耶特沿德维纳河和苏霍纳河旅行时，经过了皮拉斯附近的浅滩。

english: Pyriatyn stands on the Udai, among the river valleys of left-bank Ukraine. The Hypatian Chronicle mentions the town in 1155. It later belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and then to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. In 1592 King Sigismund III granted Magdeburg rights through Prince Aleksander Wiśniowiecki, linking the town's renewal to the powerful family whose estates stretched across the region. After the uprising of 1648, Pyriatyn became a Cossack company town, first within the Kropyvna Regiment and later the Lubny Regiment. Its old market and churches remained the centre of the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 皮里亚京位于乌克兰左岸的乌代河谷。《伊帕季耶夫编年史》在1155年提到这座城镇。它后来属于立陶宛大公国，再归波兰立陶宛联邦。1592年，齐格蒙特三世国王通过亚历山大·维什涅韦茨基亲王授予此地马格德堡法，城镇复兴与这个在地区拥有广阔地产的家族密切相连。1648年起义后，皮里亚京成为哥萨克百人队驻地，先后属于克罗皮夫纳团和卢布尼团。古老的市场与教堂仍是周围乡村的中心。

english:
Pyrzyce, historically known in German as Pyritz, stands in the agricultural country of Pomerania south of the Baltic coast. A medieval town grew near the older fortified settlement, with a central marketplace and walls. Duke Barnim I granted it civic rights in 1263; its Szczecin and Bańskie gates guarded the northern and southern approaches.

The town belonged to the duchy ruled by the Pomeranian Griffin dynasty. The Reformation changed religious institutions in the sixteenth century, and the Thirty Years' War disrupted the region. After the ducal line died out, competing claims reshaped Pomerania; Pyrzyce eventually passed into the Brandenburg-Prussian sphere. Its markets and fortifications remained closely tied to the agricultural land around it.
simp_chinese:
佩日采的历史德语名称为皮里茨，位于波罗的海海岸以南的波美拉尼亚农业地区。中世纪城镇在较早的设防聚落附近发展起来，设有中央市场并筑有城墙。1263年，公爵巴尼姆一世授予其城市权利；什切青门与巴涅门分别守卫北、南入口。

这里属于波美拉尼亚格里芬王朝统治的公国。十六世纪宗教改革改变了宗教机构，三十年战争又扰乱整个地区。公爵家系绝嗣后，各方争夺重塑了波美拉尼亚的归属；佩日采最终进入勃兰登堡—普鲁士的势力范围。城镇的市场与防御设施仍同周围农业土地紧密相连。

english: Pyshchug lies near the river of that name and the Vetluga, in the forested country between the Volga and northern river basins. The settlement appears in 1616 as the village of Ivakino; by 1659 it was known as Nikolskoye. A route followed the Vetluga and Pyshchug toward a portage to the Kudanga and Yug, leading onward to Veliky Ustyug and the Northern Dvina. Its waterways thus connected the Volga country with the trade routes of the north.
simp_chinese: 佩舒格位于同名河及韦特卢加河附近，坐落在伏尔加河与北方水系之间的森林地带。1616年，这个聚落以伊瓦基诺村之名见于记载；到1659年，它已称尼科利斯科耶。一条路线沿韦特卢加河和佩舒格河通向拖船路，再经库丹加河、尤格河抵达大乌斯秋格和北德维纳河。水路因而将伏尔加地区与北方贸易路线联系起来。

english: Pyti is the Parkatêjê name for the Tocantins River, a great waterway flowing north through central Brazil. Its course passes wooded savannas and forest before reaching the lowlands near the Amazon. Timbira-speaking peoples have long inhabited country near the river, and their place names preserve connections to its plants and landscape. The river and its tributaries form a network through the interior.
simp_chinese: 皮蒂是帕卡泰杰人对托坎廷斯河的称呼。这条大河穿过巴西中部向北流淌，经过林地稀树草原和森林，最终抵达亚马逊附近的低地。操廷比拉语的民族长期居住在河流附近，他们的地名保存着与植物和景观之间的联系。河流及其支流构成穿越内陆的水系网络。

english: Pyuthan was a hill principality of western Nepal, counted among the Chaubisi Rajya or twenty-four states. Its neighbours included Gulmi, Argha and Palpa, other small kingdoms of the mountain country. Gorkhali forces conquered Pyuthan in 1786 as their kingdom expanded westward. A later royal order appointed a custodian to conduct worship of Gorakhnath at Pyuthan, with land set aside to support the rituals.
simp_chinese: 皮乌坦是尼泊尔西部的山地小邦，属于称为乔比西的二十四邦之一。邻邦包括古尔米、阿尔加和帕尔帕等山地王国。1786年，向西扩张的廓尔喀军队征服皮乌坦。后来一份王室命令任命负责人主持当地戈勒克纳特的祭祀，并拨出土地维持仪式。

english:
Pyzdry is an old royal town of Greater Poland, first recorded in 1232 during an invasion by the Silesian duke Henry the Bearded. After the Teutonic Knights burned it in 1331, Casimir the Great ordered a castle and defensive walls built. He also chose Pyzdry as a place to conclude a truce with John of Bohemia in 1345 and to present legal statutes for Greater Poland the following year.

In 1390 Władysław Jagiełło received the homage of Duke Wartislaw VII of Pomerania here. Pyzdry later served as a county seat and a gathering place for the Kalisz Voivodeship's levy. Swedish soldiers captured and plundered it in 1655, and a great fire followed in 1768. After the Second Partition in 1793, the town passed to Prussia, then to the Duchy of Warsaw and Congress Poland.
simp_chinese:
佩兹德雷是大波兰的一座古老王室城镇，最早见于1232年西里西亚公爵大胡子亨里克入侵时的记载。1331年条顿骑士团焚毁此地后，卡齐米日大帝下令修建城堡和城墙。1345年，他在佩兹德雷与波希米亚的约翰订立停战协议，次年又在此颁布大波兰的法律章程。

1390年，瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃在此接受波美拉尼亚公爵瓦尔蒂斯瓦夫七世的臣服。佩兹德雷后来成为县治，也是卡利什省贵族征召军的集结地。1655年瑞典军攻占并劫掠城镇，1768年这里又发生大火。1793年第二次瓜分波兰后，城镇先后归属普鲁士、华沙公国和波兰会议王国。

english: The Shuswap River flows southwest out of Sugar Lake through a valley in the interior mountains of British Columbia. Near Cherry Creek it turns west, then north toward Mabel Lake. Chinook and coho salmon travel into this river system, whose waters eventually reach Shuswap Lake through Mara Lake. Forested mountain slopes rise on either side of the river and its tributary streams.
simp_chinese: 舒斯瓦普河流出舒格湖后，向西南穿过不列颠哥伦比亚内陆山地的河谷。在樱桃溪附近，河流转向西，再向北流向梅布尔湖。奇努克鲑与银鲑进入这一水系；河水最终经马拉湖流入舒斯瓦普湖。森林覆盖的山坡耸立在河流及其支流两侧。

english:
Qabala was an ancient walled city at the southern foot of the Greater Caucasus and an early capital of Caucasian Albania. Its position between mountain streams helped protect the settlement, while trade and crafts sustained it long after the royal capital moved to Barda. Its ruins preserve traces of pagan, Christian and Islamic religious life, reflecting successive changes in the region.

Qabala endured attacks by Georgian and Mongol armies in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries. Timur's campaign reached it in the late fourteenth century, and Shah Tahmasp I attacked it in 1538. Despite repeated invasions, occupation continued in the fortified area known as Gala into the eighteenth century. The surviving walls and gates recall a city whose history stretched from classical antiquity into the age of the Safavids and Nader Shah.
simp_chinese:
卡巴拉是大高加索南麓的一座古老城墙城市，曾是高加索阿尔巴尼亚的早期都城。两条山溪之间的位置有利于防守，王国都城迁往巴尔达后，贸易与手工业仍支撑着此地。遗址中保存着异教、基督教与伊斯兰教宗教生活的痕迹，反映了地区历次变迁。

十二至十三世纪，卡巴拉遭受格鲁吉亚和蒙古军队的进攻。十四世纪末帖木儿的军队抵达此地，1538年塔赫马斯普一世又发动进攻。尽管屡受侵扰，称为加拉的设防区仍有人居住，直到十八世纪。残存的城墙与城门见证了这座城市从古典时代延续至萨法维和纳迪尔沙时代的漫长历史。

english:
Al-Qadisiyyah is associated with the edge of the Iraqi plain near Kufa, where cultivated land approaches the Arabian desert. Its name is remembered for the early Islamic battle that helped bring Sasanian rule in Iraq to an end.

Medieval geographers listed al-Qadisiyyah as a station after Kufa on the Darb Zubaydah, the pilgrimage route to Mecca. The road links the name to a wider history of travellers crossing between Iraq and the Arabian Peninsula,.
simp_chinese:
卡迪西亚与库法附近的伊拉克平原边缘有关，耕地在此接近阿拉伯沙漠。这一名称因伊斯兰早期一场帮助结束萨珊王朝在伊拉克统治的战役而为人所知。

中世纪地理学家将卡迪西亚列为从库法前往麦加的祖拜达朝觐道上的一处驿站。道路将这一地名与往来伊拉克和阿拉伯半岛的旅人联系起来。

english:
Qaen was a principal town of Quhistan, set among the dry mountains and cultivated valleys of eastern Iran. Saffron and fruit grew in its surrounding district, while a fortress above the town belonged to the network of Nizari Ismaili strongholds. In the eleventh century the traveller Nasir Khusraw described Qaen as a large fortified city with a moat and a Friday mosque distinguished by a magnificent arch.

The congregational mosque associated with the later town bears an inscription dating its construction to 796 AH, or 1393–94, under Jamshid ibn Qarin. Its great iwan preserves the monumental character that travellers admired in the region's mosques, though the earlier mosque described by Nasir Khusraw stood at the older city. Qaen remained a centre of the wider Qayenat district, and in 1732 Nader Shah appointed a member of the Khuzayma family its governor. Their descendants continued to exercise authority in the area around Qaen and Birjand.
simp_chinese:
加延是库希斯坦的主要城镇，坐落在伊朗东部干燥山地与耕作河谷之间。周围出产藏红花与水果，城上堡垒属于尼扎里派伊斯玛仪派的据点网络。十一世纪旅行者纳西尔·霍斯劳称加延是一座大型设防城市，城外有壕沟，聚礼清真寺有一座宏伟拱门。

后来城镇的聚礼清真寺铭文记载，其由贾姆希德·伊本·卡林下令建于伊斯兰历796年，即1393至1394年。巨大的伊万保留了当地清真寺为旅人称道的宏伟风格，但纳西尔·霍斯劳所述的更早清真寺位于旧城。加延仍是加延纳特地区的中心，1732年纳迪尔沙阿任命胡扎伊马家族成员为当地总督。其后代继续在加延与比尔詹德周边行使权力。

english: Qagaan Tayaĝungin, the people of the east, were Unangan communities of the Alaska Peninsula and the islands near its tip. Their country included the Shumagin and Sanak Islands and reached west towards Unimak. The sea supplied fish, birds and marine mammals, while skin boats connected settlements across the island passages. In the eighteenth century Russian traders sought sea otter skins along this coast, bringing new demands and violence to its people.
simp_chinese: 卡甘塔亚贡金意为东方之民，是阿拉斯加半岛及其尖端附近岛屿的乌南甘社群。他们的土地包括舒马金群岛和萨纳克群岛，向西延伸至乌尼马克。海洋提供鱼类、鸟类和海兽，皮船则穿越岛间水道，连接各处聚落。十八世纪俄国商人在沿岸寻求海獭皮，给居民带来新的索取与暴力。

english: Qaĝiiĝun is a name for the Unangan people of the Shumagin Islands, south of the Alaska Peninsula. Their island home faces the North Pacific, with sea mammals, fish and birds providing food and materials. Skin boats enabled hunters to move between islands and along the peninsula’s coast. In the eighteenth century Russian traders entered these waters seeking sea otter pelts, relying on Unangan hunters while bringing violence and coercion to the island communities.
simp_chinese: 卡吉贡是阿拉斯加半岛以南舒马金群岛的乌南甘居民之名。他们的岛屿家园面向北太平洋，海兽、鱼类和鸟类提供食物与材料。猎人乘皮船往来于岛屿及半岛海岸。十八世纪，俄国商人为海獭皮进入这片水域，依靠乌南甘猎人，同时给岛上社群带来暴力和强迫。

english: Qahqaheh is a fortress set high in the mountains north of Meshginshahr. Its steep approaches made it a secure prison for important captives of the Safavid dynasty. Prince Ismail Mirza, a son of Shah Tahmasp I, spent about twenty years confined here. After his father's death in 1576, his supporters brought him from the fortress to Qazvin, where he was crowned Shah Ismail II.
simp_chinese: 卡赫卡赫是一座高踞梅什金沙赫尔以北山地的堡垒，险峻的道路使它成为萨法维王朝关押重要囚犯的牢固监狱。沙阿塔赫马斯普一世之子伊斯玛仪米尔扎在此囚禁约二十年。1576年父亲去世后，他的支持者将他从堡垒带往加兹温，他在那里加冕为沙阿伊斯玛仪二世。

english: Qaisar lies in the hill country of Faryab, near the river of the same name. Snowmelt in the Band-e Turkestan feeds the Qaysar and its tributaries; the river rises sharply in spring and can dwindle to almost nothing through the dry months. Downstream it joins the Maimana River, and their combined waters continue as the Shor Darya.
simp_chinese: 卡萨尔位于法里亚布丘陵，靠近同名河流。突厥斯坦山脉的融雪补给卡萨尔河及其支流；河水春季猛涨，干旱月份则可能几乎断流。下游的卡萨尔河与迈马纳河汇合，合流后称作肖尔达里亚。

sources.title: A hydrological Atlas of Faryab Province.pdf

english:
Qakh lies beneath the wooded southern slopes of the Greater Caucasus, where the Kurmuk River leaves the mountains for the Alazani plain. Nearby Ilisu was the seat of a sultanate whose rulers governed a district between the mountains and the lowlands. The stone tower of Sumuq Qala, on the left bank of the river near Ilisu, recalls the fortified residences and local powers of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

The sultans of Ilisu dealt with the Safavid rulers and neighbouring communities while retaining local authority. In 1803 an agreement brought Ilisu and the Jar-Balakan communities under Russian protection. Their position on the mountain frontier continued to make the district important in the struggles that followed Russia's expansion into the South Caucasus.
simp_chinese:
卡赫坐落在大高加索森林覆盖的南坡下，库尔穆克河在此离开群山，流向阿拉扎尼平原。附近的伊利苏曾是苏丹国的治所，统治者管辖山地与低地之间的地区。伊利苏附近河流左岸的苏穆格卡拉石塔令人想起十七、十八世纪的设防住所与地方势力。

伊利苏苏丹与萨法维统治者及邻近社群周旋，同时维持地方权力。1803年的协议使伊利苏和贾尔—巴拉坎诸社群接受俄国保护。随着俄国向南高加索扩张，这片山地边疆在此后的斗争中依然具有重要地位。

english:
Qalat ibn Salama is a fortress in the high country near Frenda, overlooking the lands of the central Maghreb. Its name is inseparable from Ibn Khaldun, the historian and former court official who found refuge here with his family. Away from the rival courts he had served, he began a work that would explore the rise and decline of dynasties and the bonds holding human societies together.

In 1375 Ibn Khaldun entered the protection of the Awlad Arif and spent the next several years at the fortress. Here he developed the Muqaddimah, the introduction to his universal history. Seeking books and documents for the larger work, he eventually returned to Tunis. The quiet of Ibn Salama had given him a place to turn a lifetime of political experience into a new account of history.
simp_chinese:
伊本·萨拉马堡坐落在弗伦达附近的高地，俯瞰中马格里布的土地。它的名字与史家伊本·赫勒敦密不可分；这位曾在宫廷任职的学者带着家人在此避居。远离他曾服务过的互相竞争的宫廷后，他开始构思一部探讨王朝兴衰及维系人类社会纽带的著作。

1375年，伊本·赫勒敦得到奥拉德·阿里夫部族的保护，在堡中度过了接下来的数年。他在这里构思《历史绪论》，作为其世界史的导论。为了给更大的著作寻找书籍和文献，他最终返回突尼斯。萨拉马堡的宁静使他得以将一生的政治经验化为对历史的新解释。

english: Qala-i Fath stands on the lower Helmand, where the river approaches the flat plain of Sar-o-Tar. Built in the fifteenth century, its citadel was enclosed by walls and towers. Three large canals drew water from the Helmand near the fortress to irrigate the plain to the east. Historical records place the site's abandonment in the eighteenth century, after which sand spread over the former fields and settlements.
simp_chinese: 法特赫堡坐落在赫尔曼德河下游，河流在此接近平坦的萨尔塔尔平原。城堡建于十五世纪，内城由城墙和塔楼环绕。三条大运河在堡垒附近引取赫尔曼德河水，灌溉东面的平原。历史记载显示该地点于十八世纪被废弃，此后流沙逐渐覆盖了昔日的田地和聚落。

english: Qala of Kohistan lies in the mountainous country south of Maymana. Kohistan means a land of mountains, a fitting name for this southern part of Faryab, where ridges and valleys divide the highland settlements from the plains farther north. The fortress name Qala is found throughout the Persian-speaking world, but here it belongs to the local centre of this rugged district, amid the western extensions of the Afghan highlands.
simp_chinese: 科希斯坦堡位于迈马纳以南的山区。科希斯坦意为“山地”，这个名字适合法里亚布南部的景观：山脊与河谷将高地聚落同更北方的平原隔开。波斯语世界许多地方都有名为卡拉的堡垒，此处则是阿富汗高地西延山地中这一崎岖地区的聚落中心。

english: Qala-e Naw lies among the hills of Badghis, north of Herat. The surrounding country is known for its pistachio woods, a characteristic already noted by the fourteenth-century geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi. At harvest time, he wrote, people gathered the nuts and sold them in neighbouring districts. The hills and valleys of Badghis separate the Hari valley from the lands watered by the Murghab farther north, and their scattered trees give the dry slopes a distinctive appearance.
simp_chinese: 伊瑙堡位于赫拉特以北的巴德吉斯丘陵中。周边以开心果林闻名，十四世纪地理学家哈姆达拉·穆斯陶菲已注意到这一特色。他记述说，收获季节人们聚集采摘果实，再到邻近地区出售。巴德吉斯的丘陵和河谷将哈里河谷与更北面的穆尔加布河流域分开，零散树木使干燥山坡呈现出独特景象。

sources.title: The Lands Of The Eastern Caliphate (IA landsoftheeaster028596mbp).pdf

english: Qala-i Safid, the White Castle, stands in the mountainous country of Mamasani east of Fahliyan. Also called Diz-i Safid, it occupies an isolated mountain that rises above its surroundings. Its commanding site made the stronghold a refuge in the rugged western reaches of Fars, where ridges and valleys divide the country into distinct districts. A village nearby shares the name of the old fortress.
simp_chinese: 萨菲德堡意为“白堡”，位于法赫利扬以东的马马萨尼山区，也称迪兹·萨菲德。城堡所在的山峰孤立耸起，周围没有更高的山岭俯瞰其上。这处险要的据点是法尔斯西部山地中的避难所，山脊和河谷将当地分隔为不同区域。附近的村庄也沿用这座古堡的名字。

english:
Qala-e Zari belongs to the dry uplands of Quhistan in eastern Iran, associated with routes around Birjand. Settlement depended on water and workable land among hills, basins and arid stretches. Irrigated plots, gardens, livestock and crafts supported communities; trade connected the wider districts with Khorasan and routes toward neighbouring borderlands.

In the later medieval and early modern periods, local authorities navigated changing relationships with larger Iranian powers. Fortified centres, revenue arrangements and cooperation with regional elites helped sustain rule. Safavid authority brought a new imperial and religious framework, followed by eighteenth-century upheaval. Caravans and markets continued to connect rural producers with distant customers despite insecurity.
simp_chinese:
扎里堡属于伊朗东部库希斯坦干旱高地，与比尔詹德一带的道路相联系。丘陵、盆地与旱地之间的聚落依靠水源和可耕土地。灌溉田、园地、牲畜和手工业支持居民，贸易则将广大地区与呼罗珊及邻近边地相连。

中世纪后期和近代早期，地方当局与更大的伊朗政权保持不断变化的关系。设防中心、赋税安排及地方上层的合作帮助维系统治。萨法维王朝建立新的帝国与宗教框架，十八世纪又出现动荡。尽管存在安全风险，商队和市场仍将乡村生产者与远方顾客联系起来。

english: Qaladiza stands in the Peshdar plain along the upper reaches of the Little Zab. The narrow plain curves between the river and the Zagros mountains to the east. South of the town lie the ancient mounds of Qalat-i Dinka and Gird-i Bazar, remains of a settlement that occupied this river corridor long before the Kurdish town took its present form. The surrounding mountains and watercourses define a route between the plains of northern Iraq and the Iranian highlands.
simp_chinese: 卡拉迪扎位于小扎卜河上游的佩什达尔平原。狭窄平原在河流与东面的扎格罗斯山脉之间弯曲伸展。城镇以南有卡拉特丁卡和吉尔德巴扎尔古丘，留下远早于库尔德城镇形成的河谷聚落遗迹。周围山岭和水道构成伊拉克北部平原与伊朗高地之间的通道。

english:
Qal'ai Khumb stands where a tributary meets the Panj in the steep mountain country of Darvaz. It became the capital of a principality whose rulers held territory on both banks of the upper Oxus. The surrounding ridges and narrow river valleys made Darvaz difficult to control from outside, while connecting its rulers with neighbouring Badakhshan and the Pamirs.

In 1637–38 an Uzbek force took the fortress of Qal'ai Khumb and killed the ruler Shah Gharib. His brother Shah Qirghiz was installed in his place. By the middle of the seventeenth century Uzbek power had been expelled and a line of rulers styling themselves shahs of Darvaz governed independently. They fought the rulers of Badakhshan over Ragh and claimed authority farther east in Shughnan. Their followers received shares of land revenues and the proceeds of successful raids.
simp_chinese:
胡姆布堡位于达尔瓦兹陡峭山地中，一条支流在此汇入喷赤河。它成为达尔瓦兹小国的首府，统治者的领地跨越阿姆河上游两岸。山脊与狭窄河谷使外来势力难以控制当地，同时也将其与邻近的巴达赫尚及帕米尔地区相连。

1637至1638年，乌兹别克军队攻取胡姆布堡，杀死统治者沙阿·加里卜，改立其兄弟沙阿·吉尔吉兹。到十七世纪中叶，乌兹别克势力被逐出，一支自称达尔瓦兹沙阿的家族独立统治。他们与巴达赫尚统治者争夺拉格，也向更东面的舒格南提出权利主张。统治者的追随者分享土地收入和成功劫掠所得。

english:
Qalancaq belongs to the northern Black Sea steppe, in the broad country adjoining Crimea and the lower Dnieper. Open grasslands supported mobile pastoral life, with water sources and seasonal grazing determining the practical geography of movement. Horses, sheep and other livestock provided food, materials and exchangeable wealth. Routes across the steppe linked camps and settlements with markets toward Crimea, the Black Sea coast and the river valleys farther north.

During the later medieval and early modern centuries, the wider region was connected with the Crimean Khanate and Nogai pastoral groups. Warfare, raiding and the trade in captives could disrupt communities across the steppe. After the Russian annexation of Crimea and northern Tavria in 1783, new settlement changed the area. In 1794, according to local historical accounts, families exiled after the Turbai uprising settled beside the Kalanchak River; the later settlement developed along a trade route.
simp_chinese:
卡兰恰克属于黑海北部草原，位于克里米亚与第聂伯河下游相邻的广阔地区。开阔草地支持流动畜牧生活，水源和季节牧场决定实际移动路线。马、羊及其他牲畜提供食物、材料和可交换财富。草原通道把营地与聚落连接到克里米亚、黑海沿岸及更北方河谷的市场。

中世纪后期和近世，更广阔的地区与克里米亚汗国及诺盖牧民有关。战争、劫掠和俘虏贸易可能扰乱草原各地的社群。1783年俄国吞并克里米亚与北塔夫里亚后，新的定居逐渐改变当地。地方历史记载称，1794年因参加图尔巴伊起义而被流放的家庭在卡兰恰克河畔定居；后来的聚落沿商路发展。

english: The fort of Bishah stood on a low hill near the palms lining the valley, not far from al-Rawshan. Its circular walls were built of earth, with a second wall and a covered passage inside; round towers provided positions from which defenders could fire. A traveller accompanying an Egyptian campaign described the fort in 1834, recalling the resistance of Ali al-Suayri to the Ottoman forces. Entry to such forts, he observed, was made by rope rather than through an ordinary gate.
simp_chinese: 比沙堡坐落在低丘上，靠近谷地沿岸的枣椰林，离拉乌尚不远。堡垒以土筑成圆形外墙，内部还有第二道墙和带顶通道；圆塔为守军提供射击位置。1834年，一位随埃及远征军同行的旅行者描述了这座堡垒，并提到阿里·苏艾里曾在此抵抗奥斯曼军队。他观察到，这类堡垒须借绳索进入，而非经由普通大门。

english: Qalat-i Ghilzai stands on the road between Kandahar and Ghazni, its fortress commanding the approaches through the dry southern Afghan uplands. The town takes its name from the Ghilzai, a major Pashtun tribal group of the region. In the early eighteenth century a Ghilzai chief, Mir Wais Hotak, overthrew Safavid rule at Kandahar, and his successors carried their power into Persia.
simp_chinese: 吉勒宰堡坐落在坎大哈与加兹尼之间的道路上，堡垒控制着穿越阿富汗南部干燥高地的通路。城镇得名于当地重要的普什图部族吉勒宰。十八世纪初，吉勒宰首领米尔·韦斯·霍塔克推翻了萨法维人在坎大哈的统治，他的继承者随后将势力扩张至波斯。

english: Qaleh Ganj lies in the warm lowlands of southern Kerman, in the broader Rudbar country near the Jazmurian basin. Once known as Kalat-e Ganj, the settlement takes its name from a fort. The Deh Poli River descends from the southwestern heights towards Jazmurian, and date palms grow in the surrounding country. The region has long been home to communities of varied backgrounds, including Baluch people.
simp_chinese: 甘吉堡位于克尔曼南部温暖的低地，属于贾兹穆里安盆地附近广阔的鲁德巴尔地区。聚落旧称卡拉特甘吉，名字源自一座堡垒。代赫波利河从西南高地流向贾兹穆里安，周围地区生长着椰枣树。长期以来，包括俾路支人在内、不同背景的社群生活在这里。

english:
Qalhat stood on Oman's eastern coast as a major port of the Kingdom of Hormuz. Its walls and archaeological remains testify to connections linking Arabia with East Africa, India, China and Southeast Asia. Horses, dates, incense and pearls were among the goods associated with its trade; the rulers of Hormuz also used the town as a seasonal residence and refuge.

Travellers described Qalhat and its monuments, including the shrine associated with Bibi Maryam. Portuguese attacks in the sixteenth century contributed to the port's decline, and the old city was abandoned by the end of that century. Its remains preserve the outline of a once-important Indian Ocean trading centre.
simp_chinese:
盖勒哈特位于阿曼东岸，是霍尔木兹王国的重要港口。城墙与考古遗存见证阿拉伯同东非、印度、中国及东南亚的联系。马匹、椰枣、乳香和珍珠是相关贸易货物；霍尔木兹统治者也曾以此为季节居所和避难地。

旅人记述过盖勒哈特及其建筑，包括与比比·玛丽亚姆相关的圣陵。十六世纪葡萄牙袭击促使港口衰落，至世纪末古城已被废弃。遗存保留了这座曾经重要的印度洋贸易中心的轮廓。

english: Qalyub lies north of Cairo at the head of the Nile Delta, where the river divides into branches that nourish Lower Egypt. The town gave its name to the surrounding district and appears in accounts of the Arab conquest and the Fatimid period. Fields and irrigation channels spread across the low land around it, placing Qalyub within the cultivated landscape between Egypt's capital and the towns of the Delta.
simp_chinese: 盖勒尤卜位于开罗以北、尼罗河三角洲的顶端，河流在这里分成滋养下埃及的支流。城镇为周围地区命名，阿拉伯征服和法蒂玛王朝时期的记载都提到过它。田地与灌溉渠道分布在周围低地，使盖勒尤卜成为埃及首都与三角洲城镇之间农业景观的一部分。

english: Qaminis stands on the low coastal plain south of Benghazi, beside the Gulf of Sirte. The settlement was known as Chaminos in antiquity. Along this shore dunes separate the sea from lagoons and marshes, and shallow inland depressions form salt flats. The plain rises gradually inland toward the edge of the Cyrenaican uplands, contrasting with the greener hills of Jebel Akhdar farther to the northeast.
simp_chinese: 卡米尼斯位于班加西以南的低平海岸，濒临锡德拉湾。古代这里的聚落称为卡米诺斯。沿岸沙丘将海水与内侧的潟湖、沼泽隔开，内陆浅洼则形成盐碱地。平原向内陆逐渐升高，通往昔兰尼加高地边缘，与东北方较为青翠的杰贝勒阿赫达尔山丘形成对照。

english: Qamystybas lies in the lower Syr Darya delta, east of the Aral Sea. The elongated lake is linked to Laikol at its southwestern end, and its area varies with the river's water supply. Its water is slightly saline, the bottom sandy, and stretches of the shore rise in bluffs. Reeds grow along the lake, whose waters support fish.
simp_chinese: 卡梅斯特巴斯湖位于锡尔河下游三角洲，在咸海以东。狭长的湖泊西南端与莱科尔湖相通，面积随河水补给而变化。湖水微咸，湖底多沙，部分岸边有陡崖。湖畔生长芦苇，水中有鱼类栖息。

english: Changbalik was an Uyghur town on the northern side of the Tianshan, known to Chinese writers as Changbali or Changbala. In the early thirteenth century the Daoist master Qiu Chuji passed through on his journey west to meet Chinggis Khan. His account describes a welcome by the local Uyghur ruler and mentions Buddhist monks. The town stood among the settlements and cultivated oases along the northern approaches to the Tianshan.
simp_chinese: 昌八剌是天山北侧的一座回鹘城镇，汉文史籍也称彰八里或昌八里。十三世纪初，道士丘处机西行觐见成吉思汗时经过此地。他的行记记载当地回鹘统治者迎接使团，也提到了佛教僧人。这座城镇属于天山北麓的聚落与绿洲地带。

english: Qandala is a port on the Gulf of Aden, backed by the rugged hills of northeastern Somalia. The mountains are home to frankincense trees, whose fragrant resin has long been a prized product of the Somali coast. Harvesters collect the hardened tears from cuts in the bark, and merchants carry them to the shore for exchange. Qandala's harbour connects these dry uplands with markets across the sea.
simp_chinese: 坎达拉是亚丁湾畔的一座港口，背靠索马里东北部崎岖的山丘。山中生长着乳香树，其芬芳树脂长期以来是索马里海岸珍贵的出产。采集者从树皮的切口收取凝固的树脂，商人再将其带到海岸交换。坎达拉港把干旱高地与海外市场连接起来。

english:
Qandhar belongs to the upper Marathwada country of the Deccan, where cultivated plains, fortified places and routes between larger centres supported a rural market society. Grain farming supplied households and military establishments, while livestock and crafts broadened production. Markets connected villages with towns, carrying food, materials and manufactured goods. A stronghold could influence movement and revenue, but its practical strength depended on the labour and resources of the surrounding countryside.

Kandhar Fort is attributed to the Rashtrakuta king Krishna III, placing its origins in the tenth century. In 1631 a Mughal army under Nasiri Khan captured it after a siege. The wider Deccan experienced changing rule among sultanates, Mughal authorities and later Hyderabad and Maratha powers. The stronghold's history illustrates the importance of fortified places in a region whose political rulers drew upon the labour and resources of surrounding agricultural communities.
simp_chinese:
此处坎达哈属于德干上马拉特瓦达，耕作平原、设防地点和较大中心之间道路，支持农村市集社会。谷物农业供应家庭、军事机构，牲畜和手工业扩大生产。市场联系村庄、城镇，运送食物、材料与制成品。堡垒可以影响通行、收入，但实际力量依赖周围乡村劳动和资源。居民通过地方知识、家庭合作及伙伴，维持农田、运输和长期交换，也使军事中心获得日常供应。

坎达哈堡的修建通常归于罗湿陀罗拘陀国王克里希纳三世，其起源可追溯到十世纪。1631年，纳西里汗统率的莫卧儿军队围攻并夺取该堡。更广阔的德干地区先后经历苏丹国、莫卧儿及后来的海得拉巴和马拉塔势力统治。堡垒历史体现设防地点的重要性，周围农业社群的劳动和资源则支撑地方政治权力。

english: The Qaqet jungle covers part of the Baining Mountains in the east of New Britain. Steep, forested slopes lie between the coasts of the island, and the Qaqet language belongs to a family distinct from the Austronesian languages of many coastal neighbours. Within this mountainous country, gardens and paths make clearings in the forest, while streams run down towards the surrounding shores.
simp_chinese: 卡凯特丛林位于新不列颠岛东部的拜宁山地。陡峭的森林山坡横亘于岛屿的海岸之间，卡凯特语所属的语系不同于许多沿岸邻居使用的南岛语系。山地居民在林中开辟园地与道路，溪流则从坡上流向四周海岸。

english: The coast around Qaqortoq opens into the fjords of southern Greenland, where Norse farms once stood on sheltered land above the water. At Hvalsey, a stone church witnessed the marriage of two Icelandic visitors in 1408; a certificate issued the following year at Garðar remains among the last written records of the Greenland Norse. In 1775 the trader Anders Olsen founded the colony of Julianehåb at Qaqortoq, making the harbor a new center for trade and mission in the region.
simp_chinese: 卡科尔托克海岸通向格陵兰南部的峡湾，北欧农场曾坐落在水边上方受庇护的土地上。1408年，华尔塞石教堂见证了两位冰岛来客的婚礼；次年在加尔扎尔出具的证明，是格陵兰北欧人留下的最后文字记录之一。1775年，商人安德斯·奥尔森在卡科尔托克创建尤利安娜霍布殖民地，使港口成为地区贸易与传教的新中心。

english: Qar Ka La is a name used by a Qom community in the Santa Fe plains. The Qom, also called Toba, speak a Guaycuruan language and traditionally inhabited the Gran Chaco to the north. Hunting, fishing and gathering sustained their communities in a country of woodland, grassland and rivers. During the colonial period the Chaco frontier saw encounters between Indigenous peoples, missionaries and settlements expanding from the Paraná.
simp_chinese: 卡尔卡拉是圣菲平原一个科姆社群使用的名称。科姆人也称托巴人，使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言，传统上居住在北方的大查科。人们在林地、草地和河流交错的土地上狩猎、捕鱼与采集。殖民时代，查科边疆的原住民族与传教士及从巴拉那河扩展的聚落相遇。

english: The Qaradagh mountains rise south of the Aras River in northern Azerbaijan. Deep ravines and forested slopes descend toward the river, while higher ridges hold open meadows. Oak, hornbeam and maple grow in the Arasbaran woods, a landscape linking the vegetation of the Caucasus with that of the Iranian plateau. The steep country shelters scattered villages and mountain pastures.
simp_chinese: 卡拉达格山脉耸立在阿塞拜疆北部阿拉斯河南岸。深谷和森林山坡向河流下降，高处山脊则分布着开阔草甸。阿拉斯巴兰林地中生长着橡树、鹅耳枥和枫树，连接了高加索与伊朗高原的植被景观。陡峭山区庇护着零散村庄和山地牧场。

english: The eastern heights of Qaradagh stand between Ahar and the valleys descending toward the Aras. Dry foothills give way to higher ridges and patches of deciduous forest, with grassland on the exposed summits. The deep valleys of Arasbaran carry streams northward, and the differences in altitude create a striking range of landscapes within a short distance of the river.
simp_chinese: 卡拉达格东部高地位于阿哈尔与向阿拉斯河下降的谷地之间。干燥山麓逐渐过渡为高山脊和片片落叶林，暴露的山顶上则有草场。阿拉斯巴兰的深谷将溪流向北引去，高度差异使靠近河流的有限地区内呈现出多种截然不同的景观。

english: The highlands around Tabriz belong to the mountainous country of Azarbaijan, where volcanic heights and ridges rise above intervening plains. South of the city, the great mass of Sahand dominates the landscape, its slopes descending toward Lake Urmia and the valleys of the plateau. Snow and streams from these heights feed the cultivated districts below, while the open uplands provide pasture in the warmer months.
simp_chinese: 大不里士周围的高地属于阿塞拜疆山地，火山高峰与山脊耸立在其间的平原之上。城南的萨汉德山雄踞一方，山坡向乌尔米耶湖和高原河谷倾斜。高山积雪和溪流滋养下方耕地，开阔的高地则在温暖季节提供牧场。

english: East of Tabriz the uplands of Azarbaijan rise toward Sabalan, a great volcanic mountain above the plains around Sarab and Ardabil. Its snowy heights contrast with the cultivated valleys below. The mountain pastures formed part of the seasonal grazing grounds of the Shahsevan, whose flocks moved between the highlands in summer and the lower country during the cold months.
simp_chinese: 大不里士以东，阿塞拜疆高地逐渐升向萨巴兰山。这座巨大的火山高踞萨拉布和阿尔达比勒周围的平原之上，积雪的山峰与山下耕作的河谷形成鲜明对照。这里的山地牧场是沙赫塞万部族季节性牧地的一部分；他们夏季在高地放牧，寒冷时则迁往低地。

english: Qarah Zia od Din lies north of Khoy in the Chaypareh country of Iranian Azarbaijan. Its surroundings form part of the highland region between the basin of Lake Urmia and the Araxes, with mountain approaches leading toward Maku and Anatolia. Khoy to the south was an important centre on the caravan route from Tabriz, and the wider region became a frontier between the Ottoman and Safavid realms.
simp_chinese: 卡拉齐亚丁位于霍伊以北的伊朗阿塞拜疆恰伊帕雷地区。它周围的土地属于乌尔米耶湖盆地与阿拉斯河之间的高地，山间通道向马库和安纳托利亚延伸。南方的霍伊是大不里士商队道路上的重要中心，这一地区后来成为奥斯曼与萨法维两国之间的边疆。

english: On the Salhyr in the Crimean interior stood Ak-Mescit, the town that later became Simferopol. Its name, meaning “White Mosque,” recalls the Muslim town of the Crimean Khanate. The khans established it to protect their capital at Bakhchisaray against incursions from the steppe. According to the Ottoman traveller Evliya Çelebi, the qalgha, or heir to the khan, had a palace outside the town. Russian forces destroyed Ak-Mescit in 1736; after the annexation of Crimea, Simferopol was founded there in 1784.
simp_chinese: 克里米亚内陆的萨尔吉尔河畔坐落着阿克梅斯吉德，即后来成为辛菲罗波尔的城镇。它的名字意为「白色清真寺」，令人想起克里米亚汗国时期的穆斯林城镇。汗王建立此地，是为了保护都城巴赫奇萨赖免受草原来袭。奥斯曼旅行家埃夫利亚·切莱比记载，汗位继承人卡尔加在城外设有宫邸。1736年俄军摧毁阿克梅斯吉德；克里米亚被吞并后，辛菲罗波尔于1784年在此建立。

english: Near the Chahan Us River on the eastern edge of Qaidam, the Reshui burial grounds overlook an oasis beneath the mountains. Their tombs have yielded silk textiles, wood, ornaments and vessels. Finds from one tomb include a seal naming a Tuyuhun king, evidence of the people who lived in this region under Tibetan imperial rule.
simp_chinese: 柴达木东缘的察汗乌苏河附近，热水墓群背山面向绿洲。墓葬中出土了丝织物、木器、饰品和器皿；其中一座墓还发现刻有“吐谷浑王”的印章，留下了吐蕃统治时期当地人群的线索。

english: Qardho lies in northeastern Somalia, on the inland side of the highlands facing the Gulf of Aden. The surrounding dry country links the coastal mountains with the broad valleys and plateaus farther south. In the early modern period it formed part of the Majeerteen sultanate, a Somali polity whose rulers drew together communities across the peninsula and maintained connections with ports on the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 卡尔多位于索马里东北部、面向亚丁湾的高地内陆一侧。周围干旱地带把海岸山脉与更南方宽阔的河谷、高原连接起来。近代早期，这里属于马杰尔廷苏丹国；这个索马里政权的统治者联合半岛各地社群，并与北部海岸港口保持联系。

english: Qarnin was a village of Sistan remembered as the birthplace of Yaqub ibn Layth, founder of the Saffarid dynasty. From humble origins, Yaqub went to Zarang and worked as a coppersmith, a trade that gave the dynasty its name. In the ninth century he built a military power based in Sistan and carried his campaigns across eastern Iran and into Afghanistan, challenging the authority of the Abbasid caliphs.
simp_chinese: 咖尔宁是锡斯坦的一座村庄，以萨法尔王朝创立者雅各布·伊本·莱斯的出生地而闻名。雅各布出身寒微，后来前往扎兰季做铜匠，王朝名称便源于这一行当。九世纪，他以锡斯坦为基地建立军事势力，征战伊朗东部和阿富汗，挑战阿拔斯哈里发的权威。

english: Qarr’unaq is a Yup’ik name for Kokhanok, on the southern shore of Iliamna Lake. The immense lake is part of the Kvichak drainage, through which salmon travel inland from Bristol Bay. The surrounding country has long been shared by Yup’ik, Alutiiq and Dena’ina peoples, whose fishing and hunting made use of its lakes, rivers and shores. The name belongs to this meeting place of inland waters and the Alaska Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 卡尔乌纳克是伊利亚姆纳湖南岸科卡诺克的尤皮克语名称。这片大湖属于克维恰克河流域，鲑鱼沿河系从布里斯托尔湾进入内陆。周围地区长期为尤皮克人、阿留提克人和德纳伊纳人所生活，他们在湖泊、河流与岸边捕鱼狩猎。这个地名属于内陆水域与阿拉斯加半岛交汇的地区。

english: Deh Bid lies in the cold highlands of northern Fars, on the road between Isfahan and Shiraz. Its name, meaning willow village, belongs to a country of mountain valleys and cultivated plains between Abadeh and the Marvdasht basin. The upland route passes settlements of the Shul people as it descends towards the old heartland of Fars. Fields and grazing grounds share the high valley, whose climate is markedly cooler than the southern lowlands.
simp_chinese: 德赫比德位于法尔斯北部寒冷高地，坐落在伊斯法罕与设拉子之间的道路上。地名意为“柳树村”，周围是阿巴德与马尔夫达什特盆地之间的山谷和耕作平原。高地道路向法尔斯古老核心地区下降，经过舒尔人的聚落。田地和牧场分布在高谷之中，气候明显比南方低地凉爽。

english: Qaryat al-Ulya lies east of the al-Suman plateau in the dry interior of eastern Arabia. Its name distinguishes the higher of two neighbouring places called Qaryah from the lower Qaryat al-Sufla. The surrounding plateau is a region of rocky ground and depressions that gather water after rain, with seasonal pastures used by the people who move through the country with their herds.
simp_chinese: 卡里亚特乌利亚位于阿拉伯东部干旱内陆、苏曼高原以东。它的名字意为“上卡里亚”，与附近地势较低的“下卡里亚”相区别。周围高原遍布岩地和雨后集水的洼地，随畜群穿行的居民利用这里的季节性牧场。

english:
Al Qaryatayn belongs to the Syrian interior, where an oasis settlement offers water and cultivation near the approaches to the desert. Gardens, fields, livestock, and local exchange support a community whose value depends on resources scarce in the surrounding dry country. Routes connect the settlement with Homs, Palmyra, and other regional centres, making it part of a wider network rather than an isolated place beyond the cultivated plain.

The geographer Yaqut described al-Qaryatayn in the early thirteenth century as a village on the desert road between Homs and Palmyra, with Christian inhabitants. The town and its surroundings were raided by Mongol troops in 1260. In later centuries its location remained useful for travellers and camel transport across the Syrian interior.
simp_chinese:
卡里亚泰因属于叙利亚内陆，绿洲聚落在接近沙漠的地方提供水和耕作。园圃、田地、牲畜及地方交换，支持依赖周围旱地稀少资源的社群。路线把聚落接向霍姆斯、巴尔米拉及其他区域中心，使它参与更大网络，并非只是耕地平原之外孤立地点，水源与通行赋予其重要性。

十三世纪初，地理学家雅古特描述卡里亚泰因为霍姆斯与巴尔米拉之间沙漠道路上的村庄，居民信奉基督教。1260年，蒙古军队袭击了镇及周边地区。此后，这里的位置仍对穿越叙利亚内陆的旅人和骆驼运输有用。

english: Qasba in southern Bengal is known for a nine-domed mosque built in the style associated with Khan Jahan of Khalifatabad. Its square prayer hall is divided into bays beneath the domes, and corner towers frame the building. The design closely resembles the nine-domed mosque at Bagerhat and the Masjidkur mosque farther west, showing how a shared architectural tradition spread among the settlements of the delta.
simp_chinese: 孟加拉南部的卡斯巴以九穹顶清真寺闻名，其风格与哈里发塔巴德的汗·贾汗相联系。方形礼拜厅在穹顶下划分为若干间，四角设有塔楼。建筑设计与巴盖尔哈特的九穹顶清真寺及更西面的马斯吉德库尔清真寺十分相似，显示这种共同的建筑传统如何传播到三角洲的聚落。

english:
Qashliq, also known as Isker or Sibir, was a fortified Siberian Tatar centre on the Irtysh River. Mentioned in Russian sources from the fourteenth century, it became the capital of the Khanate of Sibir in the sixteenth and developed most extensively in that century's first half. Its ruins lie near Tobolsk.

In 1582 Cossacks led by Yermak captured and devastated Qashliq. Siberian Tatars retook the ruined town in 1584, but lost it again in 1586. Tobolsk was founded nearby in 1587 and became a more enduring centre of Russian administration. The changes ended Qashliq's role as a khanate capital, although the capture of the town did not immediately settle control of the wider region.
simp_chinese:
卡什利克又称伊斯克尔或西伯尔，是额尔齐斯河畔的一座西伯利亚鞑靼堡城。俄国文献自十四世纪起提及此地；十六世纪，它成为西伯利亚汗国的首都，并在该世纪上半叶发展最盛。遗址在托博尔斯克附近。

1582年，叶尔马克率领的哥萨克攻占并破坏卡什利克。西伯利亚鞑靼人于1584年夺回这座废城，却在1586年再次失去它。附近的托博尔斯克于1587年建立，此后成为更持久的俄国行政中心。这些变化结束了卡什利克作为汗国首都的地位，但一座城的陷落并未立即解决对广大地区的控制。

english: Qasr-i Ahnaf was a settlement near Marw al-Rudh on the Murghab River, in the country where the river leaves the mountains and runs toward the desert. Its name recalls al-Ahnaf ibn Qays, the Arab commander associated with the early Islamic conquest of the district. Marw al-Rudh grew into a significant medieval town, distinguished from the larger Marw downstream; Qasr-i Ahnaf lay in its vicinity and formed part of the settled landscape along the river.
simp_chinese: 卡斯尔·艾赫奈夫是穆尔加布河畔马尔夫鲁德附近的一处聚落，河水在这一带流出群山，奔向沙漠。地名使人想起阿拉伯统帅阿赫奈夫·本·盖斯，他与该地区早期的伊斯兰征服有关。马尔夫鲁德后来发展为重要的中世纪城镇，与下游规模更大的马尔夫相区别；卡斯尔·艾赫奈夫位于其附近，是沿河聚落的一部分。

english: Qasr al-Qaba lies in the uplands of western Najd, near the hills of Dukhul and Hawmal. Red rock rises above the surrounding desert, and water can collect in hollows among the hills. Dukhul and Hawmal are names familiar from the opening of a celebrated poem by the pre-Islamic poet Imru al-Qays, who recalled an abandoned dwelling between them.
simp_chinese: 卡巴堡位于内志西部高地，靠近杜胡勒和豪迈勒丘陵。红色岩石高出周围荒漠，丘间洼地可以蓄水。杜胡勒与豪迈勒之名见于前伊斯兰诗人伊姆鲁·盖斯的一首名篇开头：诗人追忆两地之间一处已经荒废的居所。

english: Qasr-e Qand lies in a valley of western Makran, on the Kaju River. The river descends through the mountains towards the coastal plain, where it joins the Sarbaz to form the Bahu Kalat. Villages and cultivated land are strung along the watercourse, hemmed in by dry hills. The name of the settlement recalls a fortified centre in a region where local chiefs ruled from strongholds among irrigated lands. Beyond the valley the ranges lead south towards the Sea of Oman.
simp_chinese: 甘德堡位于西马克兰的卡朱河谷。河流穿过山地向海岸平原流去，在那里与萨尔巴兹河汇合成巴胡卡拉特河。村庄与耕地沿河排列，两侧是干旱丘陵。聚落的名称使人想起昔日的设防中心；在这一地区，地方首领曾以灌溉土地间的堡垒为据点。山谷以南的群山延伸至阿曼海。

english: Qasr Farafra lies in an oasis of Egypt's Western Desert, between Bahariya to the north and Dakhla to the south. Springs made settlement possible in a depression surrounded by barren land. The old fortified qasr was built of mudbrick on stone foundations, with a protected cistern and many rooms within its walls. It was used in medieval times, while rock-cut tombs near the oasis attest to occupation in the Roman period.
simp_chinese: 卡斯尔法拉夫拉位于埃及西部沙漠的绿洲中，北面是巴哈里耶，南面是达赫莱。泉水使被荒地包围的洼地得以有人定居。古老的设防卡斯尔以石基和泥砖建成，城墙内有受保护的蓄水池和许多房间。堡垒在中世纪使用，绿洲附近的岩凿墓葬则见证了罗马时期的居住活动。

english: Qasr Himam is a locality in the dry country northeast of as-Sulayyil, near the southern edge of Najd. It is also recorded under the names Qasr Hamam and Ihmam. Rocky heights rise around the place, including Mugharah to the north and Khashm Riman to the east. Beyond them lie the sparsely settled expanses approaching Wadi ad-Dawasir and the desert to its east.
simp_chinese: 希马姆堡位于苏莱伊勒东北方的干旱地区，接近内志南缘，也见于卡斯尔·哈马姆和伊赫马姆等名称。周围耸立着岩石高地，北有穆加拉，东有哈什姆·里曼。再向外则是人口稀疏的广大地区，通往达瓦西尔谷地及其东面的沙漠。

english:
Qasr Ibrim commands the Nile from a fortified height in Lower Nubia. Its walls overlook a river corridor used by successive kingdoms, while its cathedral recalls the centuries when Nubian bishops served a Christian population. Documents preserved here in Nubian, Greek, Arabic and Turkish offer rare glimpses of the lives and rulers of the region.

After the decline of Makuria, Qasr Ibrim remained an important centre of the kingdom of Dotawo; documents from that kingdom survive here as late as 1464. In the sixteenth century the Ottomans refortified the site and installed a garrison, converting part of the cathedral into a mosque. Descendants of the garrison remained until they were expelled in 1811, bringing a long chapter of occupation to an end.
simp_chinese:
易卜林堡扼守下努比亚尼罗河畔的高地，坚固城墙俯瞰着历代王国往来的河道。城中的主教座堂见证了努比亚主教为基督教居民服务的年代；这里保存的努比亚语、希腊语、阿拉伯语和土耳其语文书，则为了解当地居民和统治者提供了珍贵线索。

马库里亚衰落后，易卜林堡仍是多塔沃王国的重要中心，现存文书最晚可追溯至1464年。十六世纪，奥斯曼人在此重修防御工事、设置驻军，并将主教座堂的一部分改为清真寺。驻军后裔一直留在这里，直到1811年被驱逐，长久的驻守历史才告一段落。

english:
Qasr-e Shirin lies beside the Alvand River near the western approaches to the Iranian plateau. Its name recalls Shirin, the celebrated beloved of the Sasanian king Khosrow II, to whom the construction of a palace here is attributed. Another Sasanian monument, the four-arched Chahar Qapu, probably served as a fire temple. The remains stand where the mountains descend towards the plains of Mesopotamia.

In 1639 the Ottoman and Safavid states concluded the peace of Qasr-e Shirin after years of war. The agreement confirmed Ottoman possession of Baghdad and much of Mesopotamia and largely reaffirmed the earlier frontier laid down at Amasya. The settlement helped end a prolonged struggle between the two empires, leaving the town's name attached to a boundary that endured through later changes of government.
simp_chinese:
席林堡位于阿尔万德河畔，靠近进入伊朗高原的西部通道。地名使人想起萨珊国王霍斯劳二世著名的爱人席林；当地宫殿的修建传统上归功于这位国王。另一座萨珊遗迹、四拱的恰哈尔卡普，很可能曾是火祠。这些建筑位于群山向美索不达米亚平原下降的地带。

多年战争之后，奥斯曼与萨法维两国于1639年缔结席林堡和约。协议确认奥斯曼占有巴格达和美索不达米亚大部，并大体重申此前阿马西亚和约规定的边界。和约帮助结束两帝国之间旷日持久的争斗，使这座城镇的名字与此后历经政权更替的边界联系在一起。

english: Al Qastal lies in the Syrian steppe near Khanasir, south of the salt flats of Jabbul. Known to early Arab writers as Khunasira, Khanasir became a fortified estate and a favoured residence of the Umayyad caliph Umar II, who ruled from 717 to 720. A long underground water channel dating to Byzantine times supplied the settlement.
simp_chinese: 盖斯泰勒位于叙利亚草原，靠近贾布勒盐沼以南的哈纳西尔。早期阿拉伯作家称哈纳西尔为胡纳西拉；这里后来成为设防庄园，也是717年至720年在位的倭马亚哈里发欧麦尔二世常住的地方。一条可追溯至拜占庭时代的地下长渠为聚落供水。

english:
Qatrun is an oasis in southern Fezzan, a green depression surrounded by the sands of the central Sahara. Date palms sustained its inhabitants, who also kept livestock and cultivated vegetables and fodder. The oasis lay on the Bornu road, which connected the Mediterranean coast with the lands south of the desert through Zawila and, later, Murzuq.

Great caravans did not necessarily stop in the oasis itself. They could rest at wells some distance away, while goods destined for Qatrun were brought to its market. Textiles and paper came south from Tripoli, and leather and wooden bowls travelled from the opposite direction. For the Toubou inhabitants, the oasis was both a home among the palms and a meeting place on a long desert road.
simp_chinese:
卡特朗是费赞南部的一处绿洲，绿色洼地四周尽是撒哈拉中部的沙漠。枣椰养育着这里的居民，他们也饲养牲畜，种植蔬菜和饲草。绿洲位于博尔努道路上，这条道路经由扎维拉、后来又经过穆尔祖格，将地中海沿岸与沙漠以南的土地连接起来。

大商队不一定进入绿洲，而是在远处的水井旁歇脚，再将准备出售的货物运往卡特朗市场。纺织品和纸张从的黎波里南下，皮革和木碗则由南方运来。对当地的图布人来说，这片绿洲既是棕榈树下的家园，也是漫长沙漠道路上的会合之处。

english: Qatruyeh stands in the arid country between Neyriz and Sirjan, near the boundary of Fars and Kerman. To the east lies the salt desert of Sirjan, known locally as Kafa-ye Qatru. This broad waste forms a natural divide between the two regions, its saline flats contrasting with the cultivated settlements at the margins. Mountain ridges break up the surrounding plateau and separate its enclosed basins.
simp_chinese: 加特鲁耶位于内里兹与锡尔詹之间的干旱地区，靠近法尔斯和克尔曼的边界。东面是锡尔詹盐漠，当地称卡法耶加特鲁。这片广阔荒地构成两地之间的天然分界，盐碱平地与边缘的耕作聚落形成鲜明对照。山脊分割着周围高原，也隔开一座座内流盆地。

english: Qatya is an oasis on the northern Sinai route between Egypt and Palestine. Date palms and wells made it a welcome stopping place amid the sandy desert. Travellers in the late fifteenth century described its gardens and its position on a road furnished with wells at intervals for those crossing from Bilbeis. Officials also examined merchants' goods and collected dues here, making the oasis a point of contact between caravans and the authorities of Egypt.
simp_chinese: 卡提亚是西奈北部埃及与巴勒斯坦之间道路上的一处绿洲。枣椰树和水井使它成为沙漠中受欢迎的歇脚地。十五世纪末的旅行者描述了这里的园地，以及从比勒拜斯通来的道路上间隔设置的水井。官员还在此查验商人货物并征收税费，使绿洲成为商队与埃及当局接触的地方。

english:
The Qawalangin are Unangan people of Unalaska and the western Fox Islands, where volcanic slopes rise above the waters between the Pacific and the Bering Sea. Villages stood on Unalaska and neighbouring Amaknak long before Russian traders arrived. People hunted sea mammals and travelled among the islands in skin boats, drawing on knowledge of currents and weather.

Russian fur hunters came to Unalaska in 1759, and trade soon gave way to open warfare. Unangan resistance in the 1760s destroyed several Russian ships, but the traders returned with armed force, inflicting heavy losses on island communities. The newcomers sought valuable sea otter skins and increasingly compelled local hunters to supply them. Later, Unalaska became a centre of Russian trade in the Aleutians.
simp_chinese:
卡瓦朗金是乌纳拉斯卡及福克斯群岛西部的乌南甘居民，火山山坡在此俯瞰太平洋与白令海之间的水域。俄国商人到来很久以前，乌纳拉斯卡和邻近的阿马克纳克岛上已有村庄。人们猎取海兽，乘皮船在岛屿之间往来，依靠对海流和天气的认识。

1759年，俄国毛皮猎人来到乌纳拉斯卡，贸易不久便演变为战争。乌南甘人在十八世纪六十年代抵抗，摧毁了数艘俄国船只；商人随后武力报复，给岛上社群造成重大损失。外来者寻求海獭皮，并日益强迫当地猎人提供毛皮。后来，乌纳拉斯卡成为俄国在阿留申群岛的贸易中心。

english: The Qaxun were Unangan people of the Rat Islands in the western Aleutians, including Kiska and Amchitka. Winds, fog and rough seas shaped the routes between their volcanic shores. Islanders hunted marine mammals and travelled in skin boats adapted to these waters. In the eighteenth century Russian fur traders advanced through the western islands in pursuit of sea otters, imposing new demands on the people whose knowledge and labour made the hunt possible.
simp_chinese: 卡洪是阿留申群岛西部拉特群岛的乌南甘居民，其土地包括基斯卡岛和阿姆奇特卡岛。强风、浓雾和汹涌海面影响火山岛岸之间的航路。岛民猎取海兽，乘适应当地水域的皮船旅行。十八世纪，俄国毛皮商为追逐海獭向西部岛屿推进，对凭借自身知识与劳动从事捕猎的居民提出新的要求。

english: Qayyarah lies beside the Tigris south of Mosul, in a district marked by natural seepages of bitumen. The name itself recalls pitch, and travellers found numerous springs of the dark substance near the river. Such deposits gave this stretch of the valley a striking character, contrasting with the cultivated land along the water and the dry plains beyond. The Tigris linked the district with Mosul upstream and the towns of central Iraq to the south.
simp_chinese: 盖亚赖位于摩苏尔以南的底格里斯河畔，附近有天然沥青渗出。地名本身与沥青有关，旅行者曾在河边见到许多冒出黑色物质的泉眼。这些矿物使河谷的这一段颇具特色，与沿河耕地和更远处的干燥平原形成对照。底格里斯河将此地与上游的摩苏尔及南方伊拉克中部城镇连接起来。

sources.title: Travels and Researches in Asia Minor, Mesopotania, Chaldea, and Armenia (in Two Volumes, Vol.II) (IA dli.granth.41532).pdf

english:
Qazvin stands on a fertile plain south of the Alborz, where routes from the Iranian plateau lead towards Azerbaijan and the Caspian mountains. Its old city grew around the Friday mosque and bazaar. Among its scholars was the historian and geographer Hamdallah Mostawfi, whose writings recorded the lands and peoples of fourteenth-century Iran. A century earlier, Mongol forces had sacked the city, an event remembered in his history.

In the sixteenth century Shah Tahmasp I established the Safavid court at Qazvin, farther from the Ottoman frontier than Tabriz. A royal precinct of gardens and pavilions rose near the older city, and the court attracted painters, calligraphers and scholars. The Chehel Sotun pavilion and the Ali Qapu gateway recall this period, when Qazvin served as the centre of the empire. Tahmasp also promoted Shiite religious institutions in a city long known for its Sunni learning, making the city an important setting for debates over religious authority and the practice of Friday prayer.

Shah Abbas I later turned his attention southwards. During the 1590s he travelled repeatedly between Qazvin and Isfahan, and by the end of the decade the latter had become the principal Safavid capital. Qazvin nevertheless retained its gardens, markets and position on the road to the northwest, together with the buildings that recalled its years as a royal city.
simp_chinese:
